scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Just a second! You're
carrying too many items
right now. You'd better
put your stuff in Kafra
Storage or you won't be
able to pick up anything new...
scripts.translation:
[范特]
等一下！你现在携带的物品太多了。
最好把东西存进卡普拉仓库，
否则你将无法拾取任何新物品...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Hi there, welcome
to my pub. So what
would you like to have?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
你好，欢迎光临我的酒馆。
那么，您想喝点什么？

scripts.text: Beer, please.
scripts.translation: 来杯啤酒

scripts.text: A cocktail, please.
scripts.translation: 来杯鸡尾酒

scripts.text: Soju, please.
scripts.translation: 来杯烧酒

scripts.text: Maybe later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再说

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Alright, let me get
you a glass of beer on
tap. There you are, this
is out special Schwaltz Beer.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
好的，让我给您倒一杯生啤。
给您，这是我们特制的施瓦茨啤酒。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Gulp gulp gulp*^000000

[{0}]
Ahhh, it's really
good! That really
hits the spot!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，真好喝！
真是让人满足！

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
I'm sorry, but I have to
deliver all of our cocktail
ingredients to other customers.
Maybe I'll have enough to make
you something next time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
抱歉，我必须把所有鸡尾酒原料
都提供给其他顾客。
也许下次我会有足够的材料
为您调制一杯，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
S-soju? I'm sorry,
but we don't serve that
here. It's too much of
a tough guy drink for me...
scripts.translation:
[范特]
烧...烧酒？抱歉，
我们这里不供应那种酒。
对我来说，那太像硬汉喝的酒了...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Sure, just take
your time, relax,
and order something
when you're ready.

当然，请慢慢来，放松一下，

S-soju? I'm sorry,

here. It's too much of

scripts.translation:
[范特]
烧...烧酒？抱歉，
我们这里不供应那种酒。
对我来说，那太像硬汉喝的酒了...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Oh, did you overhear?
I'm sorry, it's just that one
of my employees had an
accident and was pretty hurt,
so I have nodoby that can
deliver this merchandise.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
哦，被你听到了？
抱歉，只是我的一名员工
出了事故，伤得很重，
所以我现在没有人手
可以运送这批货物。

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
I have an urgent order
that I need to send to
the Kiel Hyre Academy,
but I can't find anyone
that's available for this
kind of temporary job.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
我有一笔紧急订单
需要送到基尔·海尔学院，
但我找不到任何人
能胜任这种临时工作。

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that
scripts.translation: 听到这个我很遗憾

scripts.text: Do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation: 需要我帮你吗？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Well, I'm sure that I'll
figure something out.
Do you know anyone
that'd be interested in
some part time work?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
嗯，我相信我会想出办法的。
你认识对兼职工作
感兴趣的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Really? That's great!
But first, I think it's fair to
tell you that this job may not
be as simple as you'd think.
I expect you to complete the
delivery, no matter what.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
真的吗？太好了！
但首先，我觉得有必要告诉你，
这份工作可能没有你想的那么简单。
我期望你无论如何都要完成配送任务。

scripts.text: Sure I'll do it
scripts.translation: 当然，我会做的

scripts.text: Wait, let me think about it...
scripts.translation: 等等，让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
I'm glad to hear that.
Well then, please take this
bottle of Culinary Wine to
Mrs. ^ff0000Lecollane^000000 in the Kiel
Hyre Academy. I'll pay you
once you finish the job, okay?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
太好了。
那么，请把这瓶酒店的酒
送到基尔·海尔学院的
^ff0000勒科兰夫人^000000那里。
等你完成工作后，我会付你报酬的，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Sure thing. I really need
to get this done, so if you
can't do it, but know any
capable, responsible
people that can, then please
tell them about my situation.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
没问题。我真的很需要尽快完成这件事，
如果你做不了，但认识任何有能力、
负责任的人，请把我的情况告诉他们。

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Sure, just take
your time, relax,
and order something
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
当然，请慢慢来，放松一下，
想好了再点单。

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Please deliver that bottle
of Wine I gave you to Mrs.
Mrs. ^ff0000Lecollane^000000, who should be
inside the Kiel Hyre Academy.
Hurry and get it to her before she
can complain about the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
请把我给你的那瓶酒
送到基尔·海尔学院里的
^ff0000勒科兰夫人^000000那里。
快点送过去，别让她因为配送问题抱怨。

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Oh, you're back.
Thanks for making that
delivery. Just give me
a moment, and then I can
pay you in zeny, okay?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
哦，你回来了。
谢谢你的配送。请稍等片刻，
我马上用Zeny付你报酬，好吗？

scripts.text: I need more wine...
scripts.translation: 我需要更多的酒...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Oh, you need to deliver
another bottle? Alright,
let me look around, and
I'll give you the wine
and your payment.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
哦，你还需要送另一瓶？
好的，让我找找看，
我会把酒和你的报酬给你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFRummage Rummage^000000
^3355FFRummage Rummage^000000

[Vandt]
There you go!
Thank you so much
for helping me out~
scripts.translation:
[范特]
给你！
非常感谢你的帮助~

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Hey, thanks a lot
for helping me out that
last time. I knew I asked
you out of the blue, but
you ended up being a life
saver! I really appreciate it!
scripts.translation:
[范特]
嘿，非常感谢你上次的帮助。
我知道我是突然找你帮忙，
但你真是救了我一命！
我真的很感激！

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
You're a really good
worker, you know that?
Dependable, responsible,
willing to help others, and
proactive too! I think you'll
go far in life, kid, I really do~
scripts.translation:
[范特]
你真是个好工人，你知道吗？
可靠、负责、乐于助人，
而且很主动！我觉得你以后
会很有出息的，孩子，我真的这么认为~

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Arrrggghhh...
This can't be good...
This isn't good at all!
What am I suposed to do?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
啊...啊...
这不对劲...
这完全不对劲！
我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Fresh, crunchy toast!
If you want some, come
and get some tooooast~
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
新鲜酥脆的吐司！
如果你想要，快来买吐司吧~

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Fresh, crunchy toast!
If you want some, come
and get some tooooast~
Oh! Hi hi~ Did you want
to buy some yummy toast?
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
新鲜酥脆的吐司！
如果你想要，快来买吐司吧~
哦！你好你好~你想买美味的吐司吗？

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Would you please go to
the Lighthalzen Windmill
and tell them that Cezu needs
lots of flour and lots of eggs!
Then, bring all the stuff over
to me as soon as you can~
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
请你去里希塔乐镇的风车磨坊，
告诉他们塞祖需要很多面粉和很多鸡蛋！
然后，尽快把所有东西带给我~

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Hey, you're back with the
ingredients! Thank you so
much, I really needed these!
Now please give this flour
and these eggs to Elly, and
send her my regards. See you~
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
嘿，你带着食材回来了！
非常感谢，我真的很需要这些！
现在请把这些面粉和鸡蛋给艾莉，
并代我向她问好。再见~

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Hot, fresh and
cruuuunchy toast!
Come and get some!
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
热乎乎、新鲜又酥脆的吐司！
快来买吧！

scripts.text: I'm here for Elly
scripts.translation: 我是来找艾莉的

scripts.text: No, thanks
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Oh, I see. Elly must have
wasted another batch of
ingredients again. Well,
she's a regular customer,
so I really want to help, but
I can't really do anything.
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
哦，我明白了。艾莉肯定又浪费了一批食材。
嗯，她是个常客，
我真的很想帮忙，但我真的无能为力。

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
You see, I just ran
out of ingredients too!
But I can't really leave
to get some more. What if
people need to buy toast?
Listen, can you help me out?
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
你看，我的食材也刚好用完了！
但我实在走不开去买新的。
万一有人来买吐司怎么办？
听着，能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Would you please go get
some flour and eggs for me
from the ^3355FFLighthalzen Windmill^000000
Then, when you come back, I can
divide the ingredients, and you
can deliver some to Elly.
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
请去^3355FF里希塔乐镇的风车^000000帮我买些面粉和鸡蛋。
等你回来，我把食材分好，
你就可以把那份送给艾莉了。

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
I know that I'm basically
making you do everything
on your own, but please try
to understand that my hands
are tied. D-don't ask me
why, they just are!
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
我知道这基本上是在让你一个人忙前忙后，
但请体谅一下，我确实身不由己。
别...别问我为什么，反正就是这样！

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Okay okay~
Please come again!
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
好的好的~
欢迎下次再来！

scripts.text:
Hot, fresh and
cruuuunchy toast!
Come and get some!
scripts.translation:
热乎乎、新鲜又酥脆的吐司！
快来买吧！

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Hey, you've got too much
stuff on you right now. 
Put your junk in Kafra Storage
if you expect me to give you
anything. That's why you came
here to the miss, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
嘿，你现在身上带的东西太多了。
想让我给你东西，先把你的破烂存进卡普拉仓库。
你大老远跑来找我，不就是这个原因吗？

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Hey, whaddya want?
I'm pretty busy right
now, so you mind coming
back later? Then we'll talk.
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
嘿，你要什么？
我现在挺忙的，
你介意稍后再来吗？到时候我们再谈。

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Hey, whaddya want?
You just happened to
catch me at a good time,
but if you need anything,
you'd better spit it out quick
before things get hectic again.
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
嘿，你要什么？
你来得正好，我刚好有空，
但如果你有什么事，
最好趁现在赶紧说，
不然一会儿又要忙起来了。

scripts.text: I'm here for Cezu
scripts.translation: 我是来找塞祖的

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Oh, Cezu from the
toast stand? Okay,
I've got everything
that kid needs right
here. There's eggs inside,
so be really careful with it.
It's ready for you...
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
哦，是卖吐司摊的塞祖啊。
好的，
那个小孩需要的东西我这儿都有。
里面有鸡蛋，所以拿的时候小心点。
给你备好了...

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Kid's one of my regular
customers, so you don't
have to pay me, or run any
extra errands on my end. Yeah,
I know how other people treat
you adventurers. Well, see ya.
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
那小孩是我的常客，
所以不用付钱，也不用在我这儿跑腿。
嗯，我知道其他人是怎么对待你们这些冒险者的。
好了，再见。

scripts.text:
[Mills]
......
Um, okay, well, if
you need something,
just hollar, I guess.
Cuts, Cutz where are you?
You'd better not be goofing off!
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
......
嗯，好吧，
如果你需要什么，
就喊一声吧。
库茨，库茨，你在哪？
你最好别在偷懒！

scripts.text:
[Mills]
That Cutz is such
a lazy rascal. The guy
thinks he can fool around
when he's on the clock...!
Ah well, he knows I can't find
a better assistant. He'll learn...
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
那个库茨真是个懒鬼。
这家伙以为上班时可以随便玩...！
唉，反正我也找不到更好的助手了。他会学的...

scripts.text:
[Cutz]
Man, why are we
always so busy?
Why does Mills have
to work me to the bone?
Eh, it's a living, I suppose...
scripts.translation:
[库茨]
天哪，为什么我们总是这么忙？
为什么米尔斯要把我累死累活？
呃，不过这也是为了生计吧...

scripts.text:
[Cutz]
Wh-what makes you
think I'm goofing off,
Mills? L-look, look,
my hands are moving,
I'm busy, I'm working!
scripts.translation:
[库茨]
你...你怎么认为我在偷懒，
米尔斯？看...看，
我的手在动，
我很忙，我在干活！

scripts.text:
[Cutz]
Hey, you're from
Cezu's toast stand,
right? How is cute
little Cezu doing?
scripts.translation:
[库茨]
嘿，你是从
塞祖的吐司摊来的吧？
那个可爱的塞祖最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Hanie]
Oh, I wish I could study
at the Kiel Hyre Academy...
All of the graduates get
really nice jobs! I'm almost
jealous of the students!
scripts.translation:
[哈妮]
哦，我真希望能去
基尔·海尔学院读书...
那里的毕业生都能找到很好的工作！
我都快羡慕那些学生了！

scripts.text: Kiel Hyre Academy?
scripts.translation: 基尔·海尔学院？

scripts.text:
[Hanie]
Oh, the Kiel Hyre Academy
is a school founded by Kiel
Hyre, an inventor that became
rich from his strange machines.
He decided to give back to society
by building this private academy.
scripts.translation:
[哈妮]
哦，基尔·海尔学院是由基尔·海尔创立的。
他是一位发明家，靠那些奇怪的机器发了财。
他决定回馈社会，于是建立了这所私立学院。

scripts.text:
[Hanie]
However, the school will
only accept orphans that are
too poor to enroll in any other
schools. Sometimes, it makes
me wish that I was an orphan too!
Well, not really, but you know...
scripts.translation:
[哈妮]
不过，这所学校只接收
穷得读不起其他学校的孤儿。
有时候，我真希望自己也是个孤儿！
嗯，其实也不是啦，你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
I'm sorry, but if you aren't
associated with this institution,
then you're not authorized to
enter the ^FF0000Kiel Hyre Academy^000000.
Please leave if you don't have
an appointment with the staff.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
很抱歉，如果您与本院无关，
则无权进入^FF0000基尔·海尔学院^000000。
如果没有预约，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
I'm sorry, but if you aren't
associated with this institution,
then you're not authorized to
enter the ^FF0000Kiel Hyre Academy^000000.
Please leave if you don't have
an appointment with the staff.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
很抱歉，如果您与本院无关，
则无权进入^FF0000基尔·海尔学院^000000。
如果没有预约，请离开。

scripts.text: I'm here for a delivery.
scripts.translation: 我是来送货的。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
You're here to deliver
something? Okay, just give
me the recipient's ^FF0000name^000000,
followed by the ^FF0000item^000000 being
delivered, and I'll verify it
before letting you inside.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
你是来送货的？好的，请告诉我收件人的^FF0000姓名^000000，
以及所送^FF0000物品^000000的名称，
我会核实后再让你进去。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
You're here to deliver some
Wine to...to who? What was
the name? I...I don't think
we have anybody in the
academy named {0}
scripts.translation:
[保安]
你是来送...酒给谁？
叫什么名字？我...我想学院里
没有叫{0}的人。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
So you're here to make
a delivery to Mrs. Lecollane?
What is it you've brought for
her? Some ^3355FF{0}^000000?
scripts.translation:
[保安]
所以你是来给勒科兰夫人送货的？
你给她带了什么？是^3355FF{0}^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Let me buzz her first,
and check to make sure
that she's been expecting
you. Let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[保安]
让我先通知她一下，
确认她是否在等你。
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Huh. Mrs Lecollane
is expecting a delivery,
but not the item that you
say that you've brought for
her. You might want to check
to see if there's been a mixup...
scripts.translation:
[保安]
嗯。勒科兰夫人确实在等送货，
但并不是你说的那件物品。
你最好检查一下是否搞错了...

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Alright....
So you're here to
deliver a bottle of
Wine to Mrs. Lecollane?
Let me buzz her, and get
this confirmed real quickly.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
好的....
所以你是来给勒科兰夫人
送一瓶酒的？
让我通知她，
马上确认一下。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Okay, everything looks
good. Mrs. Lecollane
has been expecting you.
I guess you can enter.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
好的，一切正常。
勒科兰夫人一直在等你。
我想你可以进去了。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
If you don't have
an appoointment, then
don't loiter around in
front of the academy!
scripts.translation:
[保安]
如果没有预约，
就不要在学院门口逗留！

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Oh, did you have
other business inside
the academy? I remember
you from before, so there
shouldn't be any problems
letting you back inside...
scripts.translation:
[保安]
哦，你还有其他事要进学院吗？
我记得你，之前来过，
所以让你再进去应该没问题...

scripts.text:
[Laci]
Oh, wow! We usually
don't get visitors on
campus! Um, you're not
a new faculty member, are you?
scripts.translation:
[拉西]
哇！我们很少见到
校外的人呢！嗯，
你不是新来的老师吧？

scripts.text:
[Laci]
Hey, Nesha...!
have you heard why
Aaci hasn't been coming
to class for awhile?
scripts.translation:
[拉西]
嘿，内莎...！
你听说阿西为什么
最近没来上课吗？

scripts.text:
[Gui Nesha]
That's right, I haven't
seen Aaci in awhile.
Did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[桂内莎]
是啊，我好久没见阿西了。
发生什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Laci]
It's because....
Aaci saw a freakin' ghost!
It's one hundred percent
true! I heard about it from,
well, you know, my sources.
scripts.translation:
[拉西]
那是因为....
阿西看到了幽灵！
百分之百是真的！
我是从...你知道的，
我的消息来源那里听说的。

scripts.text:
[Gui Nesha]
...Wha...?
Oh, come on,
get outta town.
scripts.translation:
[桂内莎]
...什...么？
拜托，
别开玩笑了。

scripts.text:
[Gui Nesha]
Aren't we a little
old to be talking about
this kind of stuff? You
know, rumors and ghost
stories that make no sense?
C'mon, Laci, knock it off!
scripts.translation:
[桂内莎]
我们是不是有点大了，
还聊这种话题？
你知道的，那些毫无根据的
谣言和鬼故事？
拜托，拉西，别闹了！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
Is there a problem?
Outsiders are not allowed to come
in here, please leave.
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
有问题吗？
外人不得入内，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
Oh, hello. Ah!
have you come to
deliver my wine? The
security guard called and
mentioned you were coming.
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
哦，你好。啊！
你是来送我的酒的吧？
保安刚才打电话说
你要来。

scripts.text: Yes, that's right!
scripts.translation: 是的，没错！

scripts.text: Er, s-sorry!
scripts.translation: 啊，对...对不起！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
Well, you've come a little
later than I thought, but
I suppose it can't be helped.
I guess the waiting has just
heightened my anticipation
for this bottle of wi--
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
嗯，你来得比我预想的要晚一些，
不过我也没办法。
我想，等待反而让我
对这瓶酒——

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Cling! Crrrack!*^000000

[Mrs. Lecollane]
Elly? Elly did you
break something again?!
You've got to be more careful!
If you don't finish baking those
cookies by the end of today, your
semester grades will suffer!
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
艾莉？艾莉，你又
把什么东西弄坏了？！
你得小心一点！
如果你今天结束前不烤完那些饼干，
你的学期成绩就要受影响啦！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
B-but I just...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
但...但是我只是...

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
^FF0000Elly^000000!!

[Elly]
......
Yes, Mrs. Lecollane.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
......
好的，勒科兰夫人。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
*Ahem* Excuse me.
Would you please leave
the wine over there? You
may go now, and please
don't wander needlessly
around the academy.
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
*咳* 抱歉。
请把那瓶酒放在那边好吗？
你可以走了，请别在学院里
到处乱逛。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
Hm...?
I guess I must
be mistaken. I'm
sorry, I thought you
were somebody else.
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
嗯...？
我想我一定是
认错人了。抱歉，
我刚才以为你是别人。

scripts.text:
[Mrs Lecollane]
Well, our business is
completed, so would you
please leave the campus
as soon as you can? *Sigh*
I can't believe our future
is in these girls' hands...
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
嗯，既然事情办完了，
请尽量快点离开校园吧？*叹气*
真不敢相信我们的未来
竟然寄托在这些孩子身上...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I'm sorry, but would you
put some of your things in
your Kafra Storage first or
something? I can't really
help you when you're 
carrying so much stuff.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
抱歉，你能不能先把一些东西
存到卡普拉仓库里？
你拿着这么多东西，
我实在帮不了你。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
W-wah! Oh...!
^333333*Phew*^000000 That was close,
I almost dropped them 
again! Why do I have so much
trouble handling ingredients?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哇！啊...！
^333333*呼*^000000 好险，
差点又掉下来了！
为什么我处理食材总是这么困难？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh no, what should
I do? ^333333*Sob*^000000 Wh-what
am I going to do? ^333333*Sniff*^000000
What happened?
scripts.translation: 发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I... I have to finish baking
this batch of cookies by the
end of today, but then I spilled
all of the ingredients on the
floor. I don't know how I can
bake those cookies now...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我...我今天结束前必须烤完
这批饼干，但我把食材全都
洒在地上了。我不知道现在
还能不能烤出那些饼干...

scripts.text: What can I do to help you?
scripts.translation: 我能帮你做什么？

scripts.text: Oh, I'm so sorry.
scripts.translation: 哦，真对不起。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
What was that...?
You'll really help
me? That's wonderful!
Thank you! Thanks so much!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
刚才...？
你真的愿意帮我？
太好了！
谢谢你！太感谢了！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Wait, you don't go
to this school, don't
you? Y-you're one of
those adventurers, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
等等，你不是
这所学校的学生，对吧？
你...你是那些冒险者之一，对吗？

scripts.text: Yeah, that's right.
scripts.translation: 是的，没错。

scripts.text:
Listen, I know you
probably have your own
plans, but do  you think
you can help me with this
huge problem that I have?
scripts.translation:
听着，我知道你
可能也有自己的计划，
但你能不能帮我
解决这个巨大的难题？

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Decline
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
How Wonderful!
Thank you! Thank you
so much! I'm supposed to
finish baking this batch of
cookies soon, but I spilled
all of the ingredients...
scripts.translation:
太好了！
谢谢你！太感谢了！
我本来马上就要
烤完这批饼干了，
可是我把所有材料都洒了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm outta here.

[Elly]
W-wait...!
Come back, you
d-don't...! I really
need some help!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
等...等等...！
回来，你...你...！
我真的需要帮忙啊！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Well, I guess the only way
I can bake these cookies is
to get some new ingredients.
I'm sorry to be such a burden,
but if you didn't offer to help
me, then I'd have no one to ask!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
看来，想要烤好这些饼干，
只能去买新的材料了。
真抱歉给你添麻烦了，
但如果你不答应帮我，
我就没人可以求助了！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
You don't understand how
important it is that I bake
these cookies... If I don't
finish this assignment, then
Mrs. Crank will fail me for
the entire semester!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你不知道烤好这些饼干
对我有多重要... 如果我
完不成这个作业，
暴躁太太会让我
整个学期都不及格！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Okay, I need to calm
down. I think I can do
this with your help.
Would you please do me
this huge favor and bring
all of these ingredients?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
好了，我得冷静一下。
我觉得有你的帮忙
应该没问题。
能请你帮个大忙，
把这些材料都带给我吗？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Let's see... You can
get Wine from a pub in
Juno, Cacaos from hunting
Yoyos, and you can get flour
and Eggs from the girl that
runs the Toast Stand in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
让我想想... 你可以在
朱诺的酒馆买到葡萄酒，
打溜溜猴可以获得可可豆，
面粉和鸡蛋可以在朱诺
那个经营吐司摊的女孩那里买到。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Good luck, getting
everything, and I hope
you hurry back here with
those cookie ingredients
as quickly as you can, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
祝你好运，希望你能
尽快把这些饼干材料
带回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
*Sob*...

[Elly]
Let's see, would you
like me to remind you
which ingredients I need?
Please bring these things as
soon as you can so that I can
quickly bake some cookies~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
让我想想，你想让我
再提醒你一下
需要哪些材料吗？
请尽快把这些东西带给我，
这样我就能马上
开始烤饼干了~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Let's see... You can
get Wine from a pub in
Juno, Cacaos from hunting
Yoyos, and you can get flour
and Eggs from the girl that
runs the Toast Stand in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
让我想想... 你可以在
朱诺的酒馆买到葡萄酒，
打溜溜猴可以获得可可豆，
面粉和鸡蛋可以在朱诺
那个经营吐司摊的女孩那里买到。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hooray! Finally, I have
everything I need! This is
great! Oh, would you please
give me a moment while I bake
these cookies?  It shouldn't take
long, so hold on just a bit.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
万岁！终于
集齐所有材料了！
太棒了！哦，请你
给我一点时间
烤这些饼干好吗？
应该很快就好，
请稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Tadah! I did it!
They're finally done!
Elly's special cookies.
I'd like you to have some
as thanks for helping me out.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
当当！成功了！
终于烤好了！
艾莉特制饼干。
为了感谢你的帮忙，
我想请你尝尝。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I'm sorry, but I was so
preoccupied with baking
these cookies that I didn't
even ask for your name. I'm
^FF0000Ellyja^000000, but everybody calls me,
''Elly.'' What's your name?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
真抱歉，我刚才太专注于
烤饼干了，竟然忘了
问你的名字。我是
^FF0000艾莉嘉^000000，但大家都叫我
“艾莉”。你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
{0}?
...that name! It's wonderful!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
{0}？
...那个名字！真好听！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I'm sorry, but I have
another favor to ask you
if you don't mind helping
me out again. Don't worry,
you won't have to hurry as
quickly as you did last time.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
真抱歉，如果你不介意
再帮我的话，我还有
另一个请求。别担心，
这次你不用像上次那样
那么着急。

scripts.text: What do you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什么？

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm pretty busy...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我有点忙...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
You know how you helped
me bake those cookies?
It's the first time I was able
to do it without burning them!
I just know Grandfather'd
be so proud of me!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你知道你帮我烤饼干的事吗？
那是我第一次
没有把饼干烤焦！
我敢肯定祖父
会为我感到骄傲的！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I really want Grandfather
to taste the cookies I baked,
but the cookies will be stale
by the time I'm able to leave
campus. Would you deliver these
cookies to my grandfather for me?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我真的很想让祖父
尝尝我烤的饼干，
但等我离开校园时，
饼干可能就不新鲜了。
你能帮我把这些饼干
送给我的祖父吗？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, {0}!
Thank you so much, I knew
you'd understand! Would you
please bring the cookies to
him at ^FF0000Kiel Hyre's cottage^000000?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
啊，{0}！
太感谢你了，我就知道你会理解的！
请帮我把饼干送到^FF0000基尔·海尔的别墅^000000好吗？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, right! They're really
careful about visitors and
keeping strangers off the
property, but if you mention
my name, they'll let you in.
Alright then, see you~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦，对了！他们对访客和陌生人进入领地非常严格，
但如果你提到我的名字，他们就会让你进去。
那么，再见啦~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, um...
Okay, I'm sorry to
have bothered you...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
啊，那个...
抱歉打扰你了...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, um...
Okay, I'm sorry to
have bothered you...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
啊，那个...
抱歉打扰你了...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, you don't know where
to find Kiel Hyre's cottage?
It's just north from this
academy. Please deliver my
cookies to Grandfather, and
let him know I really miss him.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦，你不知道基尔·海尔的别墅在哪里吗？
它就在这所学院的北边。
请把我的饼干送给祖父，
并告诉他我很想念他。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hm? Grandfather's not
home? That's strange, he
didn't mention anything about
any business trips. I thought
he'd be at home all day...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯？祖父不在家？
这很奇怪，他并没有提到
要去出差。我以为
他今天会一直在家...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Would you go back to his
cottage one more time? Here,
you can use this Cottage Key.
That way, you can just go
inside and talk to him~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你能再去他的别墅一次吗？
给你，你可以用这把别墅的辅助钥匙。
这样你就可以直接进去和他说话了~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
That's so weird...
I thought Grandfather
said that he'd be at
home all day today...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
这也太奇怪了...
我以为祖父说过
他今天会一直在家...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hmm...?
What's this,
a letter for me?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯...？
这是什么，
一封给我的信？

scripts.text:
^3355FFElly opened the envelope
and started reading the letter.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾莉拆开信封，开始读信。^000000

scripts.text:
^333333Dearest Elly,
 
I have something to discuss
with my son Kiehl, so I am
leaving to meet with him.
If you don't hear from me
after 7 days after I've written
this letter, then you must
escape the academy as soon
as possible, and retrieve
something inside our 
cottage's study.
 
If you have a friend you
can trust, please ask him
to follow my traces in the
cottage. I might be in danger,
and in dire need of rescue.
 
Elly, don't trust anyone
in the academy, even your
classmates, since they may
be influenced by Kiehl.
 
Be careful, and I love you.
 
--Grandpa^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333亲爱的艾莉：

我有些事要和我的儿子基尔商量，
所以我要出发去见他。
如果你在我写完这封信后的7天内
没有收到我的消息，
你必须尽快逃离学院，
并取回我们别墅书房里的某样东西。

如果你有一个可以信任的朋友，
请让他沿着我在别墅留下的痕迹寻找。
我可能有危险，
急需救援。

艾莉，不要相信学院里的任何人，
即使是你的同学，
因为他们可能受到了基尔的影响。

小心，我爱你。

--爷爷^000000

scripts.text:
[Elly]
What? Oh no, it's been
ten days since he wrote
this letter! Ah, does this
mean that he's in danger?!
Oh no, what should I do?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
什么？天哪，他写这封信已经十天了！
啊，这难道意味着他有危险？！
天哪，我该怎么办？

scripts.text: About your grandpa
scripts.translation: 关于你爷爷的事

scripts.text: Tell me about Kiehl
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于基尔的事

scripts.text: What's with this academy?
scripts.translation: 这所学院是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh! My grandfather is
Kiel Hyre, founder and
CEO of the Kiel Hyre
foundation. He looks
strict and cold hearted,
but he's actually very nice!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦！我的祖父是基尔·海尔，
基尔·海尔基金会的创始人兼CEO。
他看起来严厉且冷酷，
但实际上非常和蔼！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
We're not related by
blood, but he's taken
care of me ever since
I lost my parents. Oh,
Grandapa, where are you?
I'm getting so worried!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我们并没有血缘关系，
但自从我失去父母后，
他一直照顾我。哦，
爷爷，你在哪里？
我好担心！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Kiehl? That's my
grandfather's son...
I don't know him that
well, and only saw him
once at an academy event.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
基尔？那是我祖父的儿子...
我不太了解他，
只在学院的一次活动上见过他一次。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Mmm, he's a good looking
guy with pale skin, silver
hair, and this cold, fierce
stare. A lot of my classmates
worship Kiehl because he's
also a business genius~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯，他是个长相英俊的男人，
皮肤白皙，银发，
眼神冰冷而锐利。
我的很多同学都很崇拜基尔，
因为他也是个商业天才~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
It's weird though...
I have no idea why my
grandpa and Kiehl don't
get along. They're both
really good at what they do...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
不过很奇怪...
我不知道为什么
爷爷和基尔关系不好。
他们俩在各自领域
都做得非常出色...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Well, I know the security
here is really tight, but
that's because everything
here is so luxurious and
expensive, you know~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯，我知道这里的
安保非常严密，
但那是因为这里的一切
都极其奢华昂贵，
你知道的~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
We also have a very
special curriculum where
you learn more of what you
want. Personally, I want to
become a great career woman
like ^0000FFMs. Allysia^000000. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我们还有非常特别的
课程体系，
你可以更多地学习
自己感兴趣的内容。
就我个人而言，
我想成为像^0000FF艾莉西亚女士^000000那样
出色的职业女性。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
This place certainly
isn't like other schools.
Yeah, everything is made to
fit each of the student's needs.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
这里确实
不像其他学校。
是的，这里的一切
都是为了满足
每位学生的需求而设立的。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Recently, though?
Some really weird stuff
has been happening. All of
my classmates are afraid of
going out alone by themselves.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
不过最近？
发生了一些非常奇怪的事情。
我的同学们都害怕
独自外出。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
But I'll be okay!
You'll be there to
rescue me from danger,
right, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
但我没问题的！
你会在那里
把我从危险中救出来，
对吧，{0}？

scripts.text: Who is Ms. Allysia?
scripts.translation: 艾莉西亚女士是谁？

scripts.text: Strange incidents?
scripts.translation: 奇怪的事件？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, Ms. Allysia is
Grandfather's secretary~
She's so beautiful, and
my grandfather really
trusts her with everything!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦，艾莉西亚女士
是爷爷的秘书~
她非常美丽，
而且爷爷非常信任她，
把一切都交给她！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Well, {0}...
I'm not supposed to tell
anyone outside of the school,
but I can trust you! You see...
We're haunted by a ghost!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯，{0}...
我不应该告诉
学校以外的人，
但我可以信任你！你看...
我们被幽灵缠上了！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I know it sounds crazy,
but this ghost wanders the
campus, and curses its victims,
making them so cold and lifeless.
It happened to my roommate,
Mayo. It's like she's a statue...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我知道这听起来很疯狂，
但这个幽灵在校园里游荡，
诅咒它的受害者，
让他们变得冰冷且毫无生气。
我的室友梅奥就发生了这种事。
她就像一尊雕像...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I snuck into the medical
office to see her, and she...
She couldn't do anything!
What would happen if the
ghost decided to curse me?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我偷偷溜进医务室
去看她，结果她...
她什么都做不了！
如果幽灵决定
诅咒我该怎么办？！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
You know what...?
If I ever got cursed
by that ghost, just yell
''^FF0000Wake up, Elly!^000000''
That'll wake me up for sure!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你知道吗...？
如果我被那个幽灵诅咒了，
只要大喊
''^FF0000醒醒，艾莉！^000000''
肯定能把我叫醒！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Argh, I'm in a fix!
I have to finish my
homework before it's due!
Yeah, I've got to go see
Mrs. Lecollane now.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
啊，我遇到麻烦了！
我必须在截止前
完成作业！
是的，我现在得去
见勒科兰夫人了。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Say, {0},
if it's okay, would you
please go find what my
grandpa left for me in
the ^FF0000cottage study^000000? You're
the only one I can trust!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
对了，{0}，
如果方便的话，
请去^FF0000小屋书房^000000
找找爷爷留给我的东西？
你是唯一让我信任的人！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Anyway, I'll see you later
in the evening! Please come
by my ^FF0000dorm room^000000. Um, the
dorms are in the church just
behind the academy, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
总之，晚上见！
请去我的^FF0000宿舍房间^000000。
嗯，宿舍就在学院后面的
教堂里，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
My room is in the back,
and it's on the ^FF0000second floor^000000
^FF0000on the left side^000000. Please use
a ladder to come up, okay?
I'll leave my window open
for you, so just come, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我的房间在后面，
在^FF0000二楼^000000
^FF0000左侧^000000。请爬梯子上来，好吗？
我会把窗户开着，
所以直接进来就好，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hurry, hurry, the
teacher's coming!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
快一点，快一点，
老师要来了！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hurry, hurry, the
teacher's coming!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
快一点，快一点，
老师要来了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can see a curtain
decorated with a cute
design through the
window of this room,
which is probably
used by a young girl.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF透过这间房的窗户，
可以看到挂着可爱图案
窗帘的房间，
这大概是
一位年轻女孩的房间。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis must be Elly's room.
It doesn't sound like anyone
is inside, so she probably
isn't back yet. For now, you
should try to find what her
grandfather left for her
in their cottage's Study.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这一定是艾莉的房间。
里面没有声音，
所以她可能还没回来。
现在，你应该去
小屋的书房找找
她祖父留给她的东西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis slightly open window
must lead into Elly's room.
Although she asked you to
find a ladder to enter her
window, you probably won't
find one. You might be able
to climb up that water pipe...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这扇半开的窗户
应该通向艾莉的房间。
虽然她让你找梯子爬进窗户，
但你大概找不到梯子。
也许可以爬那根水管上去...^000000

scripts.text: Climb Water Pipe
scripts.translation: 爬水管

scripts.text: Find Another Way
scripts.translation: 寻找其他方法

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou climbed up the
water pipe, and sneaked
into Elly's room successfully.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你爬上了水管，
成功潜入了艾莉的房间。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tried to climb
the water pipe, but
you ended up falling
and bumping your head.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你试图爬水管，
结果摔了下来，
撞到了头。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere must be some
other way to get into
Elly's room, aside from
climbing up this water pipe...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF除了爬这根水管，
一定还有别的办法
能进入艾莉的房间...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can't go up into
that open window.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你无法爬上
那扇开着的窗户。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a second...
You're carrying too
many items with you
right now, so you'll
need to free up more
Inventory space first...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF请稍等...
你现在携带的物品太多了，
需要先腾出一些
背包空间...^000000

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Who the heck are you?
Y-you're not supposed
to be able to get inside!
Get out of here right now!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你到底是什么人？
你...你不应该能进来的！
马上给我出去！

scripts.text:
^3355FFElly seems to have
been cursed, and is
completely still and
lifeless. You've got to
try something, but what?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF艾莉似乎中了诅咒，
完全静止不动，
毫无生气。你必须
做点什么，但是做什么呢？^000000

scripts.text: Wake her up by shaking.
scripts.translation: 摇晃她试图唤醒

scripts.text: Wake her up by yelling.
scripts.translation: 大声呼喊试图唤醒

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou grab Elly by the
shoulders, and try to get
her to respond by violently
shaking her entire body.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你抓住艾莉的肩膀，
用力摇晃她的身体，
试图让她做出反应。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Elly? Elly! No!
Come back to us!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
艾莉？艾莉！不！
回来吧！

scripts.text: ^3355FFElly's not responding...^000000

^3355FFAs soon as you said those
words, a ^000000Small Golden Key^3355FF
and a ^000000Button^3355FF drop from Elly's
hands. It looks like she woke
up, but only for an instant.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF就在你说出那些话的瞬间，
一把^000000小黄金钥匙^3355FF
和一个^000000按钮^3355FF从艾莉手中掉落。
看起来她醒了，
但只是一瞬间。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFElly's not responding...^000000

^3355FFAlright...
But sooner or later,
you should try to break
the curse placed on Elly.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF好吧...
但迟早，
你应该试着解除
艾莉身上的诅咒。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFMaybe the golden key^000000
unlocks something in the^000000
Cottage. Let's take another look.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也许那把黄金钥匙^000000
能打开^000000小屋里的什么东西。
让我们再仔细看看。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like Elly's
Golden Key might fit
into the keyhole on the
Grey Box you found inside
Kiel Hyre's Cottage.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看起来艾莉的
黄金钥匙可能正好能插入
你在基尔·海尔的小屋里
发现的那个灰色盒子的锁孔中。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou successfully open the
Grey Box with the Golden Key,
and find a Blue Keycard, along
with a folded note, inside the
Grey Box. You quickly read
the note's contents...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你成功用黄金钥匙打开了灰色盒子，
在盒子里发现了一张蓝色钥匙卡片，
以及一封折叠好的纸条。
你迅速读完了纸条上的内容...^000000

scripts.text:
Dearest Elly,
Kiehl finally broke the taboo,
and tried to transform you guys
into something horrible.
^FFFFFF_^000000
By the time you read this,
my life is probably in danger.
Whether I live depends on you.
^FFFFFF_^000000
You'll already learn if you
meet Puppet, but I want to tell
you myself: you're not human.
You'll learn the details if you
enter the factory by using the
entrance near the grave next
to the church. Then, I want
you to find Allysia inside
the factory's secret room.
I've registered your name in
her security system, so don't
worry. Hopefully, Allysia will
then come to save me...
^FFFFFF_^000000
Sorry about that,
Grandpa
scripts.translation:
亲爱的艾莉：
基尔终于打破了禁忌，
试图把你们变成某种可怕的东西。
^FFFFFF_^000000
等你看到这封信时，
我的生命可能已经岌岌可危。
我能否活下来，就取决于你了。
^FFFFFF_^000000
如果你见到傀儡，
你大概已经知道了，
但我想亲口告诉你：
你不是人类。
如果你使用教堂旁边
坟墓附近的入口进入工厂，
你就会知道详情。
然后，我想让你在工厂的
秘密房间里找到艾莉西亚。
我已经在她的安保系统中
登记了你的名字，所以别担心。
希望艾莉西亚能来救我...
^FFFFFF_^000000
抱歉了，
爷爷

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
discovered the note
locked inside the Grey Box.
The following message was
written in the note by Elly's
grandfather, Kiel Hyre.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里就是你发现
锁在灰色盒子里的纸条的地方。
以下是艾莉的爷爷
基尔·海尔在纸条上写的内容。^000000

scripts.text:

Kiehl finally broke the taboo,
and tried to transform you guys

worry. Hopefully, Allysia will

^FFFFFF_^000000

Grandpa
scripts.translation:

基尔终于打破了禁忌，
试图把你们变成某种可怕的东西。
^FFFFFF_^000000
等你看到这封信时，
我的生命可能已经岌岌可危。
我能否活下来，就取决于你了。

如果你见到傀儡，
你大概已经知道了，
但我想亲口告诉你：
你不是人类。

我已经在她的安保系统中
登记了你的名字，所以别担心。
希望艾莉西亚能来救我...
^FFFFFF_^000000
抱歉了，
爷爷

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a cookie
basket filled with
delicious cookies.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这是一个装满了
美味饼干的饼干篮。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis must be
Elly's cookie basket.
There appears to be
a folded note wedged
between the cookies.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这一定是艾莉的饼干篮。
看起来饼干之间
夹着一封折叠好的纸条。^000000

scripts.text: Read Note
scripts.translation: 阅读纸条

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
{0}, help!
There's this guy dressed in
black who's walking around,
and casting this weird spell!
He's the one that's been making
people cold and lifeless as
puppets! I'm getting scared!
^FFFFFF_^000000
I hope you get this note...
He ran after me, but I locked
myself in my room. I'm going
to leave my window open so that
you can still find me. I hope he
doesn't cast his curse on me!
scripts.translation:
{0}，救命！
有个穿着黑衣的家伙在四处游荡，
还施放着奇怪的魔法！
就是他让人变得冰冷僵硬，
像傀儡一样！我好害怕！
^FFFFFF_^000000
希望你能看到这封信...
他追着我跑，但我把自己锁在房间里了。
我会把窗户开着，这样你还能找到我。
希望他不要对我施下诅咒！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThat note probably
wasn't written just
for you, anyway.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那封信本来
可能就不是专门写给你的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese cookies aren't
stale yet, but they're no
longer warm. If they're
not at room temperature,
then they're a little cold.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些饼干虽然还没变质，
但已经不再温热了。如果它们
不是室温的话，那就有点凉了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you stare at the
cookie basket, the wind
from the window jostles
it, revealing a letter that
was placed underneath.
It was probably written
by Elly for you to read.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你凝视着饼干篮时，
从窗户吹进来的风使它晃动，
露出了下面放着的一封信。
那大概是艾莉写给你看的。^000000

scripts.text:
^333333Dearest {0},
 
My teachers usually yell at me
since I make so many mistakes,
but today Mrs. Lecollane gave me
praise for my yummy cookies!
It's all thanks to you, my friend.
I'm very happy we've met:
you've taught me that there
are good people in the world.
And I know Grandpa will like
you, though, I don't know
where he could be...
 
Someday, I hope to become
as nice a person as you are.
Let's keep in touch and be
really good friends, okay?
 
Yours, Elly^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333亲爱的{0}：
 
我的老师通常都会因为我犯很多错误而责骂我，
但今天勒科兰夫人却表扬了我做的饼干很美味！
这都要感谢我的朋友，是你教会了我。
我很高兴能遇见你：
你让我知道世界上还有好人。
我知道爷爷也会喜欢你的，
虽然我不知道他现在在哪里...
 
总有一天，我希望自己能变得像你一样善良。
我们要保持联系，做真正的好朋友，好吗？
 
你的，艾莉^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt feels like you can
still sense Elly's warmth
and kindness from her
cookie basket. You picked
out a cookie, and put it
in your mouth. It was
deliciously bittersweet.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF感觉你依然能从她的饼干篮中
感受到艾莉的温暖与善良。
你拿出一块饼干放入口中。
那味道苦中带甜，十分美味。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
{1}
It's time to go back. I can't
stay here much longer.

^3355FFAll the cookies
in this basket are
stale! Well, it shouldn't
come as a surprise.
It's been a long time
since they were baked.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF篮子里所有的饼干
都变质了！嗯，这也不奇怪。
它们烤好已经很久了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's just a grave.
It might be important
to you later, but now
it's not really all that
helpful to you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这只是一座坟墓。
它以后对你可能很重要，
但现在对你并没有太大帮助。^000000

like there's some kind of

和数字键盘。^000000

^3355FFWhat should you
insert into the slot?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你应该把什么

scripts.text:
^3355FFAn electronic confirmation
chime sounds once you insert
the Yellow Keycard, followed by
an automated voice that asks:^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你插入黄色钥匙卡片后，
电子确认音响起，
随后是一个自动语音问道：^000000

scripts.text:
[Security System]
Please enter the password.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
请输入密码。

scripts.text:
[Security System]
Password confirmed.
Welcome, Kiel Hyre.
scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
密码确认无误。
欢迎，基尔·海尔。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hear another 
pleasant beep, and
a secret path opens.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你听到另一声
悦耳的提示音，
一条秘密通道打开了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Security System]

scripts.translation:
[安保系统]
密码错误。
请重试。

to insert into the slot
isn't working at all...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF无论你想把什么
插入插槽，
都完全不起作用...^000000

^3355FFThe door to the
factory is wide open.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF工厂的大门
大敞着。^000000

^3355FFThe secret entrance
has now been sealed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF秘密入口
现在已经被封锁了。^000000

grave, it begins to
emit flashes of light.^000000
scripts.translation:
当你走近坟墓时，
它开始发出闪烁的光芒。^000000

scripts.translation: 使用^0000FF华丽的钥匙卡片^000000

这是私人领地，

[Cottage Keeper]
You have an
appointment with
Master Kiel Hyre?
Um, are you sure?
scripts.translation:

你和基尔·海尔师父

嗯，你确定吗？

scripts.translation:
[小屋看守]
一定是搞错了。
海尔先生如果有预约，
是不会离开的...

scripts.text:
[Cottage Keeper]
Well unless you have
an appointment, I don't
think you'll be able to
meet with Mister Hyre.
scripts.translation:
[小屋看守]
好吧，除非你有预约，
否则我想你无法
见到海尔先生。

[Cottage Keeper]
Goodbye.

再见。

^3355FFThis door is locked.

open it for you, then you'll
need the right key to unlock it.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这扇门锁着。
如果里面的人不为你开门，
你就需要正确的钥匙来解锁它。

open it for you, then you'll
need the right key to unlock it.

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou unlock the door with the
key that Elly gave you, and
as you push it open, a folded
note dropped from top of the
door. The following words
are written on this crude note.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你用艾莉给你的钥匙
打开了门，
当你推开门时，
一张折叠的纸条从门顶掉落。
这张粗糙的纸条上写着以下内容。

scripts.text:
6 Forward,
3 Left,
3 Forward,
4 Left
scripts.translation:
向前6步，
向左3步，
向前3步，
向左4步

Enter

If someone inside won't
open it for you, then you'll
need the right key to unlock it.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这扇门锁着。
如果里面的人不为你开门，

scripts.text: Open
scripts.translation: 开门

scripts.text: Cancel

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou don't have
the key that can
unlock this door.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你没有能打开这扇门的钥匙。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's just a wall.
It's not particularly
standing in your way.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这只是一堵墙。
它并没有特别挡你的路。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe wall is now
open, revealing
a secret path.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF墙壁打开了，
露出了一条秘密通道。^000000

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis bookshelf is^000000
^3355FFcrammed with many^000000
^3355FFlarge, hardcover books^000000

^3355FFWithout thinking, you
reach for a book from
the bookshelf. As you
pull it towards you, the
wall slides opens open
to reveal a secret path.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你下意识地伸手从书架上抽出一本书。
当你把它拉向自己时，
墙壁滑开了，
露出了一条秘密通道。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis bookshelf is
crammed with many
large, hardcover books.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个书架上
塞满了许多
厚重的精装之书。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a minute...!
There's something on
the floor here, but you
can't pick it up since
you're carrying too
many items now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下...！
这里地上有东西，
但你现在携带的物品太多了，
无法捡起来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a letter
on the floor. Naturally,
you pick it up, despite
the fact that it's not
addressed to you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在地上发现了一封信。
尽管信上并没有写你的名字，
但你还是自然而然地把它捡了起来。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou entered the room.^000000

^FFFFFF##^000000*Tasty-Nutricious-Delicious*
*Cute Pet Doof Vending Machine*
The best food for your Cute Pets
that is superior to the Pet Food
you can buy in the market!
^FFFFFF_^000000
Price: 1,100 zeny (cheap!)
scripts.translation:
^FFFFFF##^000000*美味-营养-可口*
*可爱宠物笨蛋自动售货机*
这是给你的可爱宠物的最佳食物，
比你在市场上买到的宠物饲料还要好！
^FFFFFF_^000000
价格：1,100 Zeny（很便宜！）

scripts.text: Buy!
scripts.translation: 购买！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, you
don't have enough
zeny to insert into
the vending machine.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF很遗憾，你的Zeny不足，
无法投入自动售货机。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOh no...!^000000
^3355FF1,100 zeny seems kind
of expensive for Pet Food,
but if it's better than the
normal stuff, it might
be worth a shot.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF糟糕...！^000000
^3355FF1,100 Zeny对于宠物饲料来说
似乎有点贵，
但如果它比普通的好，
也许值得一试。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOh no...!
There's nothing
special about it
at all! It's just
normal Pet Food!
scripts.translation:
^3355FF糟糕...！
它根本没有什么特别之处！
这就是普通的宠物饲料！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis vending machine
seems really shady and
suspicious for some reason.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这台自动售货机
不知为何看起来非常可疑。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a box filled with
ripe, delicious apples.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一个装满
成熟美味苹果的箱子。^000000

scripts.text: Take the box
scripts.translation: 拿走箱子

scripts.text: Leave it
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo...! Wait!
Something's wrong!
Whatever you do,
don't take this box!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不...！等等！
有什么不对劲！
无论如何，
都不要拿走这个箱子！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAnd so, your inner
voice, your Jungian
shadow if you will,
prevented you from
taking the box.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF于是，你内心的声音，
或者说你的荣格阴影，
阻止了你拿走箱子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSomething is wrong
with this box of apples.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这箱苹果有些不对劲。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA magnificent world map,
detailing the Rune-Midgarts
Kingdom, Schwarzwald Republic,
as well as another country to the
west whose name is unfamiliar
to you, is pasted to this wall.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF墙上贴着一张精美的大陆地图，详细描绘了卢恩·米德加兹王国、修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国，以及西边一个你闻所未闻的国家。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you examine the
world map more closely,
you find that something has
been hidden underneath it.^000000
^3355FFWhatever might be
hidden beneath this
map probably isn't
important enough for
you to investigate.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你仔细端详这张世界地图时，发现下面藏着什么东西。^000000
^3355FF藏在地图下面的东西，大概并不重要，不值得你去探究。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you examine the
world map more closely,
you find that something has
been hidden underneath it.^000000
^3355FFUnfortunately, you can't
see what's under the map
since it's pasted to the wall.
You'll need to find some
way to loosen the glue
without damaging the map...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你仔细端详这张世界地图时，发现下面藏着什么东西。^000000
^3355FF不幸的是，因为地图贴在墙上，你无法看清下面是什么。你需要想办法在不损坏地图的情况下，把胶水弄松...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you examine the
world map more closely,
you find that something has
been hidden underneath it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF当你仔细端详这张世界地图时，发现下面藏着什么东西。^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text: Examine
scripts.translation: 检查

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou bring the pot of
steaming hot liquid
close to the world map.
As the paste on the wall
moistens, the map slowly
begins to peel back.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你将那锅滚烫的液体靠近世界地图。随着墙上的胶水受潮，地图开始慢慢剥落。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe peeling map reveals
a folded piece of paper
hidden beneath it. You
take the paper, and smooth
the map out to adhere it to the
wall once again. A message is
written on the piece of paper.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF剥落的地图露出了下面藏着的一张折叠的纸。你取下那张纸，并将地图抚平重新贴回墙上。纸上写着一段文字。^000000

scripts.text:
^0000FFShe will be in a place
as cold as the poles.
When the well is dried
and the earth is cracked,
the path to her heart, a
heart as transparent as
crystal, will be open.^000000
scripts.translation:
^0000FF她将在如极地般寒冷的地方。
当井水干涸，大地龟裂，
通往她内心的道路便会开启，
那是一颗如水晶般透明的心。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFI'll have to fight four
snakes with four swords
to find her. The first sword
is love. The second sword
is despair. The third sword
is rage. The fourth sword is
hope. To find her, to rescue her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF我必须挥舞四把剑，与四条蛇战斗才能找到她。
第一把剑是爱，第二把剑是绝望，
第三把剑是愤怒，第四把剑是希望。
为了找到她，为了拯救她。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF...............................
The deeper meaning
of this poem, if it even
exists, eludes you.^000000

^3355FFThis is were you found
the paper on which the
poem was written. Perhaps
it would be a good idea to
refresh your memory and
read that poem again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里是你发现那张写有诗篇的纸的地方。也许回顾一下记忆，再读一遍那首诗是个好主意。^000000

scripts.text: Read
scripts.translation: 阅读

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^0000FFShe will be in a place
as cold as the poles.
When the well is dried
and the earth is cracked,
the path to her heart, a
heart as transparent as
crystal, will be open.^000000
scripts.translation:
^0000FF她将在如极地般寒冷的地方。
当井水干涸，大地龟裂，
通往她内心的道路便会开启，
那是一颗如水晶般透明的心。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFI'll have to fight four
snakes with four swords
to find her. The first sword
is love. The second sword
is despair. The third sword
is rage. The fourth sword is
hope. To find her, to rescue her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF我必须挥舞四把剑，与四条蛇战斗才能找到她。
第一把剑是爱，第二把剑是绝望，
第三把剑是愤怒，第四把剑是希望。
为了找到她，为了拯救她。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF...............................
The deeper meaning
of this poem, if it even
exists, eludes you.^000000

^3355FFThere's no need for
you to reread this poem.
You're a freakin' genius!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你不需要重读这首诗。
你真是个天才！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a pot
filled with boiling,
steaming liquid.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一锅沸腾冒烟的液体。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a pot
filled with boiling,
steaming liquid.
Steam... That you could
use to loosen the glue on
the map... You're a genius!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一锅沸腾冒烟的液体。
蒸汽...你可以用它来软化地图上的胶水...你真是个天才！^000000

scripts.text: Try it.
scripts.translation: 试试看

scripts.text: That? That won't work!
scripts.translation: 那样？那行不通！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou picked up the
boiling pot, but
slightly burned your
hands by accident.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拿起了那锅沸腾的液体，
但不小心烫到了手。

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo, no...
We'd better try
something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不，不...
我们最好试试别的方法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
picked up the pot filled
with steaming hot liquid.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里是你拿起那锅沸腾冒烟液体的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThat's a nice looking
calabash. You might even
get something from it...
But first you better get
rid of all your extra weight.
And by weight, I mean items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这葫芦看起来很不错。说不定能从中得到些什么...
不过首先，你得减轻一些负重。
这里的负重，指的是物品。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's an expensive
looking calabash--
or in less fancy
words, a ''gourd.''
Would do you do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这是一个看起来很昂贵的葫芦——
或者用通俗的话说，就是一个“葫芦”。
你要怎么做？^000000

scripts.text: Break Open Calabash
scripts.translation: 砸开葫芦

scripts.text: Look Inside Calabash
scripts.translation: 查看葫芦内部

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can't break
open that calabash...
You're a hero, not a vandal.
Now, if this act of vandalism
can be considered an act of
heroism, then it'd be okay.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你无法砸开那个葫芦...
你是英雄，不是破坏者。
不过，如果这种破坏行为可以被视为英雄主义的话，那倒也无妨。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tenderly place
your hand into the
calabash, and gently
feel around with your
fingers until you retrieve
an Old Bronze Key.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你温柔地将手伸进葫芦里，
用手指轻轻摸索，直到取出一把破旧铜铸钥匙。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's probably
nothing inside anyway.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF里面大概什么都没有吧。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the expensive
looking calabash from
which you've obtained
the Old Bronze Key.
It's useless to you now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这就是那个看起来很昂贵的葫芦，
你从中获得了破旧铜铸钥匙。
现在它对你来说已经没用了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a fancy pool
filled with fresh water.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个精致的池子，里面装满了清水。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a fancy pool
filled with fresh water,
along with a conscpicuous
lion statue with two handles.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一个精致的池子，里面装满了清水，
旁边还有一尊显眼的狮子雕像，带有两个把手。^000000

scripts.text: Pull Handles
scripts.translation: 拉动把手

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
Which handle would
you like to pull first?
scripts.translation: 你想先拉动哪个把手？

scripts.text: Right Handle
scripts.translation: 右侧把手

scripts.text: Left Handle
scripts.translation: 左侧把手

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pull the right
handle, causing water
to gush out of the lion's
mouth. It looks pretty cool~^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拉动了右侧的把手，
水从狮子口中喷涌而出。看起来挺酷的~^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs soon as you pull the
left handle, the water in
the pool drains away. The
pool empties, and you can
see a layer of green moss
covering the pool's bottom.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你拉动左侧的把手时，
池中的水迅速排空。池子变空了，
你可以看到池底覆盖着一层绿色的苔藓。^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text: Investigate
scripts.translation: 调查

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide that
a pool is little more
than a hole without
any water to fill it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你决定，一个没有水填充的池子，
不过就是一个坑罢了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you look through
the wet moss at the
bottom of the pool,
you stumble upon a
small, peculiar button.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你透过潮湿的苔藓看向池底时，
你发现了一个小巧而奇特的按钮。^000000

scripts.text: Press button
scripts.translation: 按下按钮

scripts.text: Don't Press Button
scripts.translation: 不按按钮

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou press the button,
which seems to trigger
a strange sound coming
from the stairs at the hallway.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你按下了按钮，
似乎触发了某种机关，
走廊尽头的楼梯处传来了奇怪的声音。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better not push
this button. Your enemies
must have hidden it carefully
for you to find: it must be
some sort of nefarious trap.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你最好不要按这个按钮。
你的敌人一定把它藏得很隐蔽，
让你发现它：这肯定是个
阴险的陷阱。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decided not
to pull any handles.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定不去拉任何把手。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you pressed
the small button that caused
some strange sound to come
from the stairs near the hallway.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里就是你按下那个小按钮的地方，
它导致走廊附近的楼梯处
传来了奇怪的声音。

scripts.text: *Grrr~*
scripts.translation: *呜呜~*

scripts.text:
^3355FFAn extremely vicious
looking dog is glaring
at you. Can you really
pass by this creature
without getting hurt?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一只看起来极其凶恶的狗
正瞪着你。你真的能
不受伤地通过这只生物吗？^000000

scripts.text: March forward
scripts.translation: 向前进

scripts.text: Run away
scripts.translation: 逃跑

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait! Perhaps you can
use food to soothe the
savage beast. Why don't
you feed it some of your Pet
Food and see what happens?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等！也许你可以
用食物来安抚这只凶猛的野兽。
为什么不喂它一些你的宠物饲料，
看看会发生什么？^000000

scripts.text: Give Pet Food
scripts.translation: 给宠物饲料

scripts.text: It won't work!
scripts.translation: 没用！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou gingerly throw the
Pet Food towards the dog.
Its tail shakes violently as
it devours the food. You'd
better pass this dog now
while you have the chance!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你小心翼翼地朝狗扔去宠物饲料。
它的尾巴剧烈地摇动，
狼吞虎咽地吃掉了食物。
趁现在有机会，你最好赶紧通过这只狗！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou slowly approach
the dog, but it won't
stop snarling at you.
You try to run past the
dog, but it blocks all of
your moves. What to do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你慢慢靠近那只狗，但它
不停地对你咆哮。
你试图从狗身边跑过去，
但它挡住了你所有的路。怎么办？^000000

scripts.text:
[Vicious Dog]
BOW WOW!
BOW WOW!
BOW WOW WOW!
scripts.translation:
[凶恶的狗]
汪汪！
汪汪！
汪汪汪！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe dog chased you
downstairs like the
suckah chump you are.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那只狗把你追到了楼下，
就像你是个笨蛋一样。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFLet's get out of here!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF我们快离开这里！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's something inside
this drawer, but you can't
take it since you're carrying
to many items with you. Maybe
you should pay a visit to your
trusty Kafra Storage first.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个抽屉里有些东西，但你拿不走，
因为你携带的物品太多了。也许
你应该先去你的卡普拉仓库看看。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find an old drawer
^that has been closed.
^If you open it, then you
^might find something
^inside. Or could it be
^empty. Who knows?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现一个旧抽屉
^它是关着的。
^如果你打开它，那么
^你可能会发现里面
^有些东西。或者可能是
^空的。谁知道呢？^000000

scripts.text: Open Drawer
scripts.translation: 打开抽屉

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou obtain a Yellow
Keycard from inside the
drawer. Opening that drawer
turned out to be worthwhile.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你从抽屉里获得了一张黄色钥匙卡片。
打开这个抽屉果然是值得的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFForget opening that
drawer. I mean, come on,
what would be the point?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF还是别打开那个抽屉了。
我是说，拜托，
那有什么意义呢？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
found the Yellow Keycard.

^3355FF这就是你找到黄色钥匙卡片的地方。

scripts.text:
^3355FFA solid box is laid
on the floor in which
a smaller, locked box
has been placed inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地板上放着一个结实的箱子，
里面装着一个较小的、上了锁的箱子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA solid box is laid
on the floor in which
a smaller, locked box
has been placed inside.
Perhaps you can use your
Old Bronze Key to unlock it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地板上放着一个结实的箱子，
里面装着一个较小的、上了锁的箱子。
也许你可以用你的破旧铜铸钥匙打开它。^000000

scripts.text: Use Old Bronze Key
scripts.translation: 使用破旧铜铸钥匙

scripts.text: No, it'll never work.
scripts.translation: 不，那肯定行不通。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYour hunch paid off!
The Old Bronze Key really
did unlock that box! You
open the inner box and
obtain the Green Keycard
that was locked inside.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你的直觉应验了！
破旧铜铸钥匙真的打开了那个箱子！
你打开里面的箱子，
获得了被锁在里面的绿色钥匙卡片。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhat...?
What? Using a key
to unlock a lock?
Come on, that's
freakin' crazy talk!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什么...？
什么？用钥匙开锁？
拜托，这简直是疯话！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the box from
which you've obtained
the Green Keycard.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这就是你获得绿色钥匙卡片的箱子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOne of the books on
this crammed bookshelf
is labeled with the note,
''To Elly.'' It must have been
left behind by her grandfather.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个塞得满满的书架上，
有一本书贴着标签，
写着“给艾莉”。
那一定是她的祖父留下的。^000000

scripts.text: Examine Book
scripts.translation: 检查书籍

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou skim through the
book's pages, and don't
find anything particularly
interesting. However, you
notice a steel surface behind the
shelf as you place the book back.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你快速翻阅了书页，
没有发现什么特别有趣的内容。
不过，当你把书放回去时，
你注意到书架后面有一块钢制表面。^000000

scripts.text: Examine the steel surface
scripts.translation: 检查钢制表面

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou remove more of the
shelf's books to reveal
that the steel surface is
part of a safe hidden behind
the bookshelf. There are two
keyholes on the steel safe.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你移开书架上更多的书，
发现那块钢制表面是
隐藏在书架后面的保险箱的一部分。
钢制保险箱上有两个钥匙孔。^000000

scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe safe opens with
a click, and you see
a Grey Box inside.
You take the Grey Box
with you, hoping that it
will come in handy later.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF保险柜“咔哒”一声打开了，
里面有一个灰色的盒子。
你拿走了灰色的盒子，
希望它以后能派上用场。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe safe won't open.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF保险柜没有打开。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's probably a better
idea to investigate the
cottage for the keys that
will open up this safe...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也许更好的办法是
去别墅里找找能打开
这个保险柜的钥匙...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou place the books
back on the bookshelf.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你把书放回了书架上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can probably
find better clues
somewhere else
around here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你也许能在
附近的其他地方
找到更好的线索。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a
bookshelf that's
crammed with books.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一个
塞满书的书架。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are piles of papers
and books stacked on top
of the desk covering topics
like artificial power, Sage
Varmundt's research, factory
robotization, and magic scrolls...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF桌上堆满了纸张和书籍，
内容涉及人造动力、
贤者瓦尔蒙特的研究、
工厂自动化以及魔法卷轴...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhile rummaging through
the books and papers, you
find a piece of paper with
the Kiel Hyre Foundation's
official seal. You decide that
it might come in handy someday.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在翻找书籍和纸张时，
你发现了一张盖有
基尔·海尔基金会
官方印章的纸张。
你觉得它以后可能会有用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've obtained
a blank piece of
paper with the Kiel
Hyre Foundation seal.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你获得了一张
盖有基尔·海尔
基金会印章的空白纸张。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are piles of papers
and books, covering various
scientific and magic topics,
stacked on top of this desk.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这张桌子上堆满了
纸张和书籍，涵盖了
各种科学和魔法主题。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis medicine cabinet
is filled with bottles of
various colors. What kind
of medicine can be found here?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个药柜里装满了
各种颜色的瓶子。
这里能找到什么样的药？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis medicine cabinet
is filled with bottles of
various colors. What kind
of medicine can be found here?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个药柜里装满了
各种颜色的瓶子。
这里能找到什么样的药？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait, you have a blank piece
of paper with the Kiel Hyre
Foundation seal! It's strange
that the seal was put on a blank
piece of paper. Maybe something
is written on it with special ink?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等，你有一张盖有
基尔·海尔基金会印章的
空白纸张！印章盖在
空白纸张上很奇怪。
也许上面用特殊墨水
写了什么？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a crazy hunch, but
maybe, just maybe, you can
use something inside this
medicine cabinet that will
reveal any invisible ink
written on this document!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这是一个疯狂的念头，
但也许，也许你可以
使用这个药柜里的东西
来显现出文件上
用隐形墨水写的字！^000000

scripts.text: What? That's crazy!
scripts.translation: 什么？太疯狂了！

scripts.text: Of course! Let's try it!
scripts.translation: 当然！试试看！

scripts.text:
^3355FFSorry.
I thought it
was a good idea...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF抱歉。
我以为这是个好主意...^000000

scripts.text: Try Red Liquid
scripts.translation: 尝试红色液体

scripts.text: Try Blue Liquid
scripts.translation: 尝试蓝色液体

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt works!
The blue liquid is
revealing small text
written on the paper.
It looks like some
kind of long poem...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF成功了！
蓝色液体显现出纸上写着的细小文字。
看起来像是某种长篇诗篇...^000000

scripts.text:
[Poem]
The first snake is made of
steel, but I used my rage
to destroy it. The second
snake is made of magic,
but my love pierced its heart.
scripts.translation:
[诗篇]
第一条蛇由钢铁铸成，
但我用怒火将其摧毁。
第二条蛇由魔法构成，
但我的爱刺穿了它的心脏。

scripts.text:
[Poem]
The third snake is flesh
and blood, but my hope
defeated it in the end.
However, the fourth and
final snake is formless, and
no one knows its appearance.
scripts.translation:
[诗篇]
第三条蛇由血肉组成，
但我的希望最终战胜了它。
然而，第四条也是最后一条蛇
无形无相，无人知晓它的模样。

scripts.text:
[Poem]
I cast my despair to the air,
but nobody knows if it killed
the snake. I am merely ^0000FFa little
lost devil^000000 with four swords and
four snakes, searching for that
girl in the darkness.
scripts.translation:
[诗篇]
我将绝望抛向空中，
但无人知晓它是否杀死了蛇。
我不过是^0000FF一个迷途的小恶魔^000000，
手持四把剑，面对四条蛇，
在黑暗中寻找那个女孩。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is a very
strange poem. What
could it possibly mean?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这是一首非常奇怪的诗。
它到底意味着什么？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNever mind.
This idea sounds
too crazy to work...
like puttting a man
on the moon. Can you
believe that hogwash?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF算了。
这个主意听起来太疯狂了，根本行不通...
就像把人送上月球一样。你能相信这种胡话吗？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tried sprinkling
the {0} liquid from the
medicine cabinet onto
the blank paper with the
Kiel Hyre Foundation seal.
However, nothing happened...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你尝试将药柜中的{0}液体
洒在带有基尔·海尔基金会印章的空白纸张上。
然而，什么也没有发生...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you poured
some blue liquid to read
a poem written in invisible
ink on the blank piece of paper
with the Kiel Hyre Foundation
seal. Would you like read it?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在这里倒了一些蓝色液体，
阅读了写在带有基尔·海尔基金会印章的
空白纸张上的隐形墨水诗篇。
你想再读一遍吗？^000000

scripts.text: No time!

scripts.text: Read

^3355FFYou're running out of
time! For now, it would
be best for you to search
