man in black menacing the
students? That was probably
^3355FFKaiser^000000, Kiehl's bodyguard.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
艾莉拿着的那个按钮上刻着^3355FF基尔的徽章^000000。
啊，还有那个威胁学生的黑衣人？
那大概是^3355FF凯撒^000000，基尔的保镖。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Kaiser...
I don't know
anything about him.
I've never even seen
his face! Kiehl just hired
him without letting me know...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
凯撒...
我对他一无所知。
我甚至从未见过他的脸！
基尔只是雇了他，没有告诉我...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
If you don't have
anymore questions for me,
then would you please
let me rest?? I'm still not
feeling well from the time
I was locked up in the factory.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
如果您没有其他问题想问我的话，
请让我休息一下好吗？
被锁在工厂里的那段时间让我至今身体不适。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Ah, I almost forgot.
Please, take this as
a little reward for
saving my life.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
啊，我差点忘了。
请收下这个，
作为我救命的谢礼。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
If you don't have
anymore questions for me,
then would you please
let me rest?? I'm still not
feeling well from the time
I was locked up in the factory.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
如果您没有其他问题想问我的话，
请让我休息一下好吗？
被锁在工厂里的那段时间让我至今身体不适。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Hm? Did you
have something
that you wanted
to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
嗯？您有什么
想问我的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't have enough
concrete evidence yet,
but I might have some
questions soon enough.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我还没有确凿的证据，
但很快我可能就会有一些问题。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Ah, {0}.
It's you. So how can
I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
啊，{0}。
是你啊。今天有什么
我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: About ^3355FFAllysia^000000...

[{0}]
You know, I was looking
through this deserted house
in Juno, and discovered
an old portrait of a woman
that looks just like Allysia.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道吗，我在朱诺的一栋废弃房子里
发现了一幅旧画像，
画中的女子看起来和艾莉西亚一模一样。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Oh...
Is that all?
I thought you had
a robotics question.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
哦...
就这？
我还以为你有机器人方面的问题。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Anyway, that's a
strange coincidence.
Well, I suppose it's
not so strange to find
look-a-likes for other people...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
总之，这是个奇怪的巧合。
不过，找到长得像别人的人
也不算太奇怪...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think it's just
a coincidence. The woman
in that thirty year old portrait
was also named Allysia, and she
worked at Orsimier street
in Juno. Does that ring a bell?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得这不仅仅是巧合。
那幅三十年前的画像中的女子
也叫艾莉西亚，
她曾在朱诺的奥斯米尔街工作。
这听起来耳熟吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then I thought that this
Allysia must have been the
woman that you loved, and
that you based your robot's
apperance on her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
然后我就想，
这个艾莉西亚一定是你深爱的女子，
而你的机器人
就是以她为原型设计的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think this is what happened:
when you were a young, poor
man, you fell in love with
Allysia. However, she was
in love with Rosimier, who
was rich and powerful.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得事情是这样的：
当你还是个贫穷的年轻人时，
你爱上了艾莉西亚。
然而，她爱的是
富有且有权势的罗西米尔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, Rosimier was
betrothed to some other
woman, and he ended up
marrying his fiancee, thus
breaking Allysia's heart.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，罗西米尔
已经与别的女子订婚，
并最终娶了他的未婚妻，
从而伤了艾莉西亚的心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Feeling betrayed, her
heart broken, Allysia jumped
into a river. Then, you decided
to get revenge on Rosimier, so
you ended up joining
Rekenber Corporation!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感到被背叛、心碎欲绝的艾莉西亚
跳河自尽了。于是，你决定
向罗西米尔复仇，
所以最后加入了
雷肯贝尔公司！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Hahahahahahaha!
Oh, what an imagination~
That's very ridiculous...
Though, I admit, maybe
I did design Allysia after
seeing that woman long ago.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
噢，想象力真丰富~
这太荒谬了...
不过，我承认，
也许我确实是在
很久以前见过那个女人后，
才设计出了艾莉西亚。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I'd almost forgotten
about her! I think we
were friends... Though,
where did you get the idea
that I might have
been in love with her?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我几乎都忘了
她！我想我们
曾经是朋友... 不过，
你哪来的想法
认为我可能
爱过她？

scripts.text: Reveal Kiel's Portrait from Hut
scripts.translation: 展示小屋里的基尔画像

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Wh-what...
How did...
Where did you...?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
什...什么...
你怎么...
你从哪里...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kiel Hyre, I found this
portrait of you as a young
man from the house of the
man that bought Allysia's ring.
I even spoke to the fisherman
that discovered Allysia's body.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
基尔·海尔，我在
买下艾莉西亚戒指的那位男子的
房子里，发现了
这幅你年轻时的画像。
我还和发现
艾莉西亚尸体的渔夫谈过话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You paid an awful lot
of money to buy Allysia's
ring. How can you not tell
me that you didn't love her?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你花了大笔的钱
买下艾莉西亚的戒指。
你怎么能告诉我
你不爱她呢？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
*Sigh...*
You got me, you got me.
I didn't want you to learn
the truth. You are correct.
I loved Allysia, and designed
my robot to look just like her.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
*叹息...*
你赢了，你赢了。
我不希望你知道真相。
你说得对。
我爱艾莉西亚，并设计
我的机器人长得和她一模一样。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I could never forget her.
Ever. But I would never
do anything to harm the
Rosimiers! I'm a scientist!
I hated him when I was young,
but things are different now!
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我永远不会忘记她。
永远。但我绝不会
做任何伤害罗西米尔家族的事！
我是一名科学家！
我年轻时恨他，
但现在情况不同了！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I shed no tears when the
Rosimiers fell, but I wasn't
responsible. Besides, I didn't
have the resources or the
capability to cause it...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
当罗西米尔家族衰落时，
我没有流下一滴眼泪，
但我也不负责任。况且，
我没有资源也没有能力
去造成这一切...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm afraid that the
evidence shows otherwise.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
恐怕
证据显示并非如此。

scripts.text: Reveal Portrait of Rosimiers
scripts.translation: 展示罗西米尔家族的画像

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Take a good look
at this portrait that
I found at the Rosimiers'
old house. Do you see
anything... incriminating?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好好看看这幅
我在罗西米尔家族
老宅里找到的画像。
你看出什么... 有罪证的吗？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Aside from that
James Rosimier, you
mean? No! I don't see
anything wrong with
this picture at all.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
除了那个
詹姆斯·罗西米尔，
你是说？不！我看
这幅画完全没问题。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Take a good look
at the pocketwatch
in the portrait. That's
the pocketwatch you
wear today, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好好看看画像里的
怀表。那就是
你今天戴的
怀表，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
...!!!

[{0}]
You might not have caused
the downfall of the Rosimiers
yourself, but with the aid of
the Rekenber Corporation, I'd
say it was entirely possible!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也许你并没有亲手
导致罗西米尔家族的覆灭，
但借助雷肯贝尔公司的力量，
我认为这完全有可能！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Well played, adventurer.
Well played. I don't regret
what I did: they killed my
Allysia! If James didn't betray
her, if only he didn't drive
her to commit suicide...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
干得好，冒险者。
干得好。我不后悔我所做的一切：
他们杀死了我的艾莉西亚！
如果詹姆士没有背叛她，
如果他没逼得她自杀就好了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's where you're wrong!
Allysia was killed, she didn't
commit suicide. Take a good
look at this note right here!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你错了！
艾莉西亚是被杀的，
她并没有自杀。
好好看看这张纸条！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
What?!
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
什么？！

scripts.text: Show James's Note
scripts.translation: 展示詹姆士的纸条

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
What does this prove?
This doesn't show that
James didn't betray Allysia.
How does this change anything?
She's dead, nothing I can do
will bring her back to me!
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
这能证明什么？
这并不能证明
詹姆士没有背叛艾莉西亚。
这改变不了什么。
她已经死了，
我做什么都无法让她回到我身边！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I never said James didn't
betray her. Look at the date
on the note. James made plans
to run away with her on August
20th. However, her body was
found on the same day.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我从未说过詹姆士没有背叛她。
看看纸条上的日期。
詹姆士计划在8月20日
和她私奔。然而，
她的尸体是在同一天被发现的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ergo, Allysia must have
died on August 19th. If she
was planning to run away with
her love on the next day, then
she had no reason to kill herself!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
因此，艾莉西亚一定是在8月19日死的。
如果她计划第二天
和她爱的人私奔，
那么她就没有理由自杀！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
No, that's not right!
She probably couldn't
trust me! She must have
realized she was nothing
but another toy to him!
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
不，不对！
她大概是不信任我！
她一定意识到
自己只是他的又一个玩物！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh yeah? I say she jumped
into the river because you
met her on that day. Now,
take a good look at this!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦？我认为她跳河
是因为你那天见了她。
现在，好好看看这个！

scripts.text: Show K.H.'s note
scripts.translation: 展示K.H.的纸条

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This note was  written by
a man with your initials,
K.H. These initials were also
signed on her portrait. You
must have written this note:
there's too many coincidences!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这张纸条是由
一个署名K.H.的人写的。
这些首字母也签在
她的画像上。
一定是你写的这张纸条：
巧合太多了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
According to this note,
you told Allysia that you
wanted to see her again
at the place you first met.
I think you did see her again...
on August 19th, the day she died!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
根据这张纸条，
你告诉艾莉西亚你想
在你们第一次见面的地方
再见她一次。
我想你确实又见了她...
在8月19日，她死亡的那天！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm assuming the place you
two first met was near the
river. No more of your lies:
Tell me what really happened!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我推测你们第一次见面的地方
在河边。别再撒谎了：
告诉我到底发生了什么！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Hah... Ha ha ha...
Yes... That's right...
That horrible night.
I remember it well...
.....................

[Kiel Hyre]
That night, when she came
to the river to meet me as
I had asked, I begged her to
run away with me, instead
of waiting for that James.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
那天晚上，当她来到河边
见我，正如我所要求的，
我恳求她跟我私奔，
而不是等那个詹姆士。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
She insisted that James
never betrayed her, and he
promised to take her away
with him the next day. Can
you imagine how that made
me feel? I was nothing to her.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
她坚持说詹姆士
从未背叛过她，
并承诺第二天会带她走。
你能想象那让我
感觉如何吗？我对她来说什么都不是。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
My feelings didn't matter to
her at all! She kept fidgeting
with that ring...I lost control
and tried to take that damned
thing away from her, and
throw it into the river...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我的感情对她来说
一点都不重要！她一直摆弄着
那枚戒指...我失控了，
试图夺走那该死的东西，
把它扔进河里...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
But you know what?
She struggled, she actually
fought me! It was just a small
fight, but then, before I knew
it, the ground underneath us
collapsed and... the rains...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
但你知道吗？
她挣扎了，她真的和我打了起来！
虽然只是一场小冲突，但就在我还没反应过来时，
我们脚下的地面突然塌陷了... 还有那场雨...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I'm not sure what it
was. The rain weakened
the ground, something went
wrong... and she just... just...
The river swallowed her...
I felt empty. She was gone.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我不确定发生了什么。
雨水让地面变得松软，出了点意外...
而她只是... 只是...
被河水吞没了...
我感到一片空虚。她不见了。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You already know that
she was found dead the
next day. But what really
broke my heart was that
she held that ring so tightly
in her hand, even in death...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
你肯定已经知道了，
第二天人们发现了她的尸体。
但真正让我心碎的是，
直到死后，她的手里都紧紧握着那枚戒指...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
His family had everything
while I had nothing. And
he had the audacity to take
Allysia away from me?!
How could that be right?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
他的家族拥有一切，
而我一无所有。
而他竟然有胆量把艾莉西亚从我身边夺走？！
这怎么可能公平？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Even though she had passed
away, I still wanted to prove
to Allysia what kind of ugly
person James really was.
That was when I joined the
Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
即使她已经去世了，
我仍然想向艾莉西亚证明，
詹姆士究竟是个多么丑陋的人。
就在那时，我加入了雷肯贝尔公司。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I designed the very first
First Generation Robot, which
I named Allysia, and sold the
designs to Rekenber. I gave them
robots, and they gave me money,
power, obedient subordinates.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我设计了第一代机器人，
并给它取名为艾莉西亚，
然后将设计图卖给了雷肯贝尔。
我给他们机器人，他们给我金钱、
权力，以及顺从的部下。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Of course I knew they'd use
my robots for spying and killing!
But you know what? It didn't
matter so long as they gave me
the means to my revenge. It was
the perfect partnership, really.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我当然知道他们会用我的机器人
进行间谍活动和杀戮！
但你知道吗？只要他们给我
复仇的手段，这就无所谓了。
这真是一段完美的合作关系。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You've got me right
where you want me.
Who are you working
for, and what exactly
do you want? My designs?
My death? Everything...?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
你把我逼到了墙角。
你是为谁工作的？
你到底想要什么？我的设计图？
我的命？还是所有的一切...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I just want
to ask about the nature
of your professional
relationship with the
Rekenber Corporation.
And about Kiehl.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，我只是想问问
你和雷肯贝尔公司
之间的职业关系。
还有关于基尔。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Kiehl, eh? After hearing
my crazy story, I'm guessing
that you already suspect the
truth about him... He's also
a robot, specifically the first
of the Second Generation models.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
基尔，是吗？
听完我这段疯狂的故事，
我猜你已经怀疑到他的真相了...
他也是一台机器人，
具体来说，是第一台第二代型号。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
His mind was developed using.
an experimental, and unstable,
form of the Condensed Magic
Spell Scrolls. He was the only
Second Generation robot that
I was allowed to keep.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
他的思维系统是基于一种
实验性且不稳定的
浓缩魔法卷轴开发的。
他是唯一一台
我被允许保留的第二代机器人。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I've become very attached
to Kiehl. It's not surprising,
seeing that robotics have
become my life. I even raised
him as my own son, and taught
him everything about robotics
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我对基尔产生了很深的感情。
这并不奇怪，
毕竟机器人技术已经成为我生命的一部分。
我甚至把他当作自己的儿子抚养，
并教给他所有关于机器人技术的知识。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Kiehl is now a genius,
and has even developed the
Third Generation of robots.
Unfortunately, I failed to
properly raise him with
human morals and ethics.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
基尔现在是个天才，
甚至开发了第三代机器人。
不幸的是，我没能
用人类的道德和伦理
正确地教育他。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
He's been transforming
the Third Generation robots
into killing machines. That's
why I tried to put them all
into the academy, so they
could learn human behavior.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
他一直在将第三代机器人
改造成杀戮机器。
所以我试图把它们都送进学院，
让它们学习人类的行为。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Although the academy
has delayed Kiehl's plans,
he has succeeded into
converting all of the robots
into uncontrollable engines
of mass destruction.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
虽然学院延缓了基尔的计划，
但他还是成功地将所有机器人
转化成了不可控的
大规模毁灭引擎。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Yes, he's been working
closely with Rekenber.
Their true objective is to
create killing machines
for Rekenber's use.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
是的，他一直在与雷肯贝尔
密切合作。
他们的真正目标是
为雷肯贝尔制造杀戮机器。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You know all the secrets
of my past now. I'm not
upset with you or anything,
but I do have something
that I want to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
你现在知道了我过去的所有秘密。
我对你并不生气，
但我有一件事想请求你。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Please! Stop Kiehl!
I don't want his madness
to destroy any more robots!
I see each and every one
of them as one of my children!
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
求你了！阻止基尔！
我不希望他的疯狂
再毁掉更多的机器人！
我把它们每一个都视为我的孩子！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I know that I must take
full responsibility for all
that has happened. I promise
to take any punishment for
my actions once everything
has been resolved.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我知道我必须为
所发生的一切承担全部责任。
我承诺，一旦事情解决，
我会接受对我行为的一切惩罚。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Okay
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: Nod
scripts.translation: 点头

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Thank you so much!
You can find Kiehl
in the underground
level in this mansion.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
非常感谢你！
你可以在这栋宅邸的
地下层找到基尔。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
He stays in the old room
where he was created, but
he reconstructed it as some
kind of cave to keep everyone
out, including me. Yes, he
doesn't trust anyone anymore...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
他待在他被创造出来的
那个旧房间里，但他把那里
改造成了某种洞穴，
以阻止任何人进入，
包括我。是的，
他不再信任任何人了...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
When you find him, I want
you to take Allysia's ring
out of his heart. If you
remove it, that should stop
him from going berserk.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
当你找到他时，
我要你取出他心脏里的
爱丽丝亚的戒指。
如果你把它取出来，
应该就能阻止他进入狂暴状态。

scripts.text: Allysia's Ring?
scripts.translation: 爱丽丝亚的戒指？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Yes... Her ring is the
beginning of everything
I put that in his heart so
that I'd never forget what
the Rosimiers did to me.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
是的...她的戒指是
一切的开端。
我把它放在他心脏里，
是为了让我永远不要忘记
罗西米埃一家对我做的事。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I think Kiehl's grown
so powerful that normal
weapons might not work
on him anymore. Use this
device that will cause his
power supply to fluctuate.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我觉得基尔已经变得
非常强大，普通的武器
可能对他不起作用了。
使用这个装置，
它会导致他的电源波动。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
If you successfully attach
this to Kiehl's body, then
he won't be able to use his
body's full power. While he's
weakened, open up his chest
and get the ring from his heart.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
如果你成功地将这个
装置安装在基尔身上，
他就无法发挥身体的
全部力量。趁他虚弱时，
打开他的胸腔，
从他的心脏里取出戒指。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Let me know once
you're ready. Then, I'll
guide you Kiehl's room.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
当你准备好时告诉我。
然后，我会指引你
前往基尔的房间。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Are you ready
to confront
Kiehl now?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
你现在准备好
面对基尔了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
There... the secret
passage is open now.
Just go to the right of
me, but be careful. Kiehl
is extremely dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
那里...秘密通道
现在打开了。
走到我的右边，
但小心点。基尔
极其危险。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Please take your
time. I imagine that
it won't be easy.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
请慢慢来。
我想这不会容易。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You're back...!
So were you able
to retrieve Allysia's
Ring from Kiehl's heart?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
你回来了...！
那么，你成功从基尔
的心脏里取出了
爱丽丝亚的戒指吗？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You mean... You don't have it?
Please, retrieve Allysia's Ring
from Kiehl's heart!
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
你的意思是...你没有拿到？
求你了，从基尔的心脏里
取出爱丽丝亚的戒指！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Wh-what happened...?
Kiehl developed a new
body for himself? Th-that
would make him a Fourth
Generation robot. I had
no idea he was this smart.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
什...发生了什么...？
基尔为自己开发了
新的身体？那...那
意味着他变成了第四代机器人。
我没想到他这么聪明。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Wait, now that I think about
it, I did see robot bodies that
looked like Kiehl when I was
locked in the factory. So he
was using those copies to
develop personal upgrades.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
等等，现在想想，
当我被锁在工厂里时，
确实看到过看起来像基尔的
机器人身体。所以
他一直在利用那些复制品
来开发个人升级。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Here, please take this
Keycard which will let you
enter and investigate the
deepest levels of the factory.
I'll investigate Kiehl's room.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
给你，请拿着这张
门禁卡，它可以让你
进入并调查工厂的最深层。
我会去调查基尔的房间。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Kiehl is my responsibility...
No matter what the cost may
be, I've got to stop him! Oh,
and here, please take this
with my thanks for all of
your help, {0} {1}.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
基尔是我的责任...
无论付出什么代价，
我都必须阻止他！哦，
还有，请收下这个，
以感谢你对我的所有帮助，
{0} {1}。

How did you get here?
Go away

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
You must be surprised
by everything that's been
happening. Maybe everything
would be easier to understand
if I explained about robots?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
您一定对最近发生的一切感到惊讶吧。
也许如果我解释一下关于机器人的事，
一切就会更容易理解了？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
The robots you've been
encountering are automated
mechanical puppets that can
independantly think and operate.
Many sages have tried to develop
their own robots, but have failed.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
您遇到的机器人是自动化的机械傀儡，
它们能够独立思考和运作。
许多贤者都曾尝试开发自己的机器人，
但都失败了。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
My master, Kiel Hyre, has
been studying robotics since
he was twenty years old, and
has developed three different
generations of robots, the first,
second, and third generations.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
我的师父基尔·海尔从二十岁起就开始研究机器人学，
并开发了三种不同世代的机器人，
分别是第一代、第二代和第三代。

scripts.text: First Generation
scripts.translation: 第一代

scripts.text: Second Generation
scripts.translation: 第二代

scripts.text: Third Generation
scripts.translation: 第三代

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
I am a good example of one
of Kiel Hyre's First Generation
robots. I was constructed using
a heavy mechanical framework,
a robotic heart, and chemically
synthesized skin covering.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
我就是基尔·海尔第一代机器人的一个典型例子。
我由沉重的机械框架、机械心脏
以及化学合成皮肤覆盖层构成。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
My central processing unit,
equivalent to your brain, is
essentially a Memory Scroll
based on the design of the
Magic Spell Scrolls that you
adventurers use in battle.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
我的中央处理单元，相当于你们的大脑，
本质上是一种记忆卷轴，
其设计基于你们冒险者在战斗中使用的魔法卷轴。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
I'm the oldest type of
humanoid robot, so I weigh
a lot, and my mind can only
process a limited amount of
data. Therefore, I can't express
emotion similarly to a human.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
我是最古老类型的人形机器人，所以体重很重，
而且我的思维只能处理有限的数据。
因此，我无法像人类那样表达情感。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
The First Generation robots
were developed from mostly
mechanical parts, but the
Second Generation robots
incorporated Homunculus
science and technology.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
第一代机器人主要由机械部件开发而成，
但第二代机器人融入了生命体科学和技术。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Second Generation robots
are more life-like since they
have artifically created skin
and flesh, although they still
are constructed from a heavy
mechanical framework.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
第二代机器人拥有人工制造的皮肤和肌肉，
因此更具生命感，
尽管它们仍然由沉重的机械框架构成。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Sage elemental scroll
technology was also used
to develop the Condensed
Memory Scroll, a central
processing unit superior to that
used in First Generation robots.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
贤者的元素卷轴技术也被用于开发浓缩记忆卷轴，
这是一种比第一代机器人使用的中央处理单元更优越的部件。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Although Condensed Memory
Scrolls were 100,000 times
more powerful than ordinary
Memory Scrolls, they were
problematic and were prone
to too many error problems.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
虽然浓缩记忆卷轴比普通记忆卷轴强大10万倍，
但它们存在缺陷，容易出现过多的错误问题。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Second Generation robots
were capable of expressing
human-like emotion, but their
production halted after six
years because they were
considered faulty.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
第二代机器人能够表达类似人类的情感，
但由于被认为存在故障，
在六年之后停止了生产。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Third Generation robots
were mostly designed by
Kiel Hyre's son, Kiehl,
and don't use a mechanical
framework at all: the entire
body is basically a homunculus.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
第三代机器人主要由基尔·海尔的儿子基尔设计，
完全不使用机械框架：
整个身体基本上就是一个生命体。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
With their organic bodies
and advanced artificial hearts
made from imitation Ymir Heart
Pieces, they can experience
physiologic phenomena
just like ordinary humans.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
凭借它们有机的身体和由仿尤米尔心脏碎片制成的先进人工心脏，
它们可以像普通人类一样体验生理现象。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Kiehl was able to develop
a more stable form of the
Condensed Memory Scroll
which does not suffer from
critical errors, and can be
cheaply mass processed.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
基尔开发出了更稳定的浓缩记忆卷轴形式，
它不会遭受严重错误，并且可以廉价地大规模处理。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Elly is actually a Third
Generation prototype. Once
we optimize the prototypes,
we will begin mass production.
In fact, the academy is our
prototype testing ground.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
艾莉实际上是一个第三代原型机。
一旦我们优化了原型机，
我们将开始大规模生产。
事实上，学院就是我们的原型机测试场。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
The fact that out prototype
robots can interact just like
real humans is proof of our
success in robotics.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
我们的原型机器人能够像真正的人类一样互动，
这证明了我们在机器人学上的成功。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Please let me know if
you'd like to learn more
about Kiel Hyre's robots.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
如果您想了解更多关于基尔·海尔的机器人的信息，
请告诉我。

[??????]

我是特工米切尔·莱拉。
从现在开始，你将为修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国效力！

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
I've got some new
information for you.
There's an old lady in
Juno that knew a woman
named Allysia 30 years ago.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
我有一些新情报给你。
朱诺有一位老妇人，
她30年前认识一位名叫艾莉西亚的女子。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
The clincher is that this
Allysia from 30 years ago
commited suicide, and is
identical to Kiel Hyre's
secretary, who is also
named Allysia.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
关键证据是，
30年前的这位艾莉西亚自杀身亡，
且与基尔·海尔的秘书长得一模一样，
那位秘书也叫艾莉西亚。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
This is too much of a
coincidence. I want you to
go to Juno and investigate.
When you're done, talk to
Kiel Hyre's steward, and
he'll send you over to me.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
这太巧合了。我要你去朱诺调查。
完成后，去找基尔·海尔的管家，
他会把你转介给我。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Yeah, I know.
That guy actually
works for me. Anyway,
when you're ready to go
to Juno, let me know, and you
can board the federal airship.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
是的，我知道。
那个家伙其实是我的人。总之，
当你准备好去朱诺时，告诉我，
你就可以登上联邦飞空艇了。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Are you ready?
I'll let you board
the federal Airship so
you can get to Juno, and
finish your mission quickly.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
准备好了吗？
我会让你登上联邦飞空艇，
前往朱诺，尽快完成任务。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Good luck. Once you
complete your mission,
make sure that you report
to Kiel Hyre's steward so
that he can send you to me.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
祝你好运。完成任务后，
记得去找基尔·海尔的管家，
让他把你转介给我。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Take your time...
But keep in mind that
I'm not a patient woman!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
慢慢来...
但请记住，
我可不是一个有耐心的人！

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Ah, you're back.
What do you have
to report from your
investigation?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
啊，你回来了。
你的调查有什么结果？

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
.....................
Ah, I see. Good work.
Why don't you go speak to Kiel
Hyre and confront him with
what you've learned about
his past? Yeah, grill him.
scripts.translation:

.....................
啊，我明白了。干得好。
不如你去和基尔·海尔对话，
用你了解到的他的过去质问他？对，好好盘问他。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Wear this hidden mic,
so we can send help if
you're endangered. I want
you to find out who Kiel
really is, and what's his
relationship to Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
戴上这个隐藏麦克风，
这样如果你遇到危险，我们可以派人支援。
我要你查清基尔的真实身份，
以及他与雷肯贝尔的关系。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]

leaving about now?
scripts.translation:

[Grandma]
Where did you go,
my darling? Where
are you, my little dear?

我的小宝贝？

scripts.text:

Say goodnight...
Hush little baby...
Go to sleeeeep~

scripts.text: What are you doing?

scripts.text: Um, I don't see a baby...

rest, so I can go to work.

and the boss is unhappy...
scripts.translation:

哦？我的宝宝一直哭个不停，
好像睡不着觉。
她需要休息，这样我才能去工作。
家里太乱了，老板也不高兴...

scripts.text: Um, I don't see a baby...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我没看到婴儿...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
What, she's right--
Well. Darling, what
are you doing? Don't
misbehave in front of
our friend! Shhh, be
good, my little girl.
scripts.translation:

什么，她说得对——
好吧。亲爱的，你在做什么？
别在我们朋友面前捣乱！
嘘，乖一点，我的小宝贝。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
What are you...?
Oh, look at that.
You made my little
darling cry! Shhh,
hush, little ^0000FFAllysia^000000.
Go to sleeeeeeep~
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你在做什么...？
哦，看看你。
你让我的小宝贝哭了！
嘘，安静点，小^0000FFAllysia^000000。
快睡吧~

scripts.text:
[Grandma]

Allysia, where did
you go? You were
supposed to come
home a while ago!
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
Allysia...？！
Allysia，你去哪里了？
你应该早就回家了！

scripts.text: Allysia? Isn't she...
scripts.translation: Allysia？难道她是...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou show Allysia's

scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向老妇人出示了Allysia的画像。^000000

scripts.text:
[Grandma]

scripts.translation:

就再也没回来！
你...你能告诉我她在哪吗？！

scripts.text:
[Grandma]

Mommy will always be
here for you. There's no

scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]

不需要难过...

[Old Lady]
Goodness, I hate this
weather! Reminds me
of how old I've gotten!
It chills my bones, it does!
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
天哪，我讨厌这种天气！
让我想起自己变老了！
真是冷得刺骨啊！

scripts.text: Do you know that grandma?
scripts.translation: 你认识那个老奶奶吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Damn it! If only I didn't
have all those adventures
in my youth! Then maybe
I wouldn't suffer so in
my advanced age!
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
该死！要是我年轻时
没有经历那些冒险就好了！
那样也许我老了就不会
这么痛苦了！

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oh... Yes. She was
the mother of my best
friend, ^3355FFAllysia^000000. Ever since
she commited suicide, things
haven't been the same. Her
mother lost her sanity...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
哦...是的。她是
我最好的朋友^3355FFAllysia^000000的母亲。
自从她自杀后，一切
都不再一样了。
她的母亲失去了理智...

scripts.text: Was ^3355FFAllysia^000000...?
scripts.translation: ^3355FFAllysia^000000是...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oh, Allysia was such
a beautiful girl. So many
men wanted her, especially
that dashing James Rosimier.
I remember hearing that they
were going to get married...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
哦，Allysia是个
非常美丽的女孩。
很多男人追求她，尤其是
那位英俊的James Rosimier。
我记得听说他们
要结婚了...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
I was so happy for her!
But then, all of a sudden,
she killed herself. Well,
that's what they all say.
Even today, I'm still not
sure what happened.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我当时为她感到高兴！
但突然之间，
她自杀了。至少
大家都这么说。
直到今天，我仍然
不确定发生了什么。

scripts.text: Wait, who's James Rosimier?
scripts.translation: 等等，James Rosimier是谁？

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oh, James belonged to
one of the oldest and richest
families in Juno. Everything
was going great for them, but
some time after Allysia died,
the family went bankrupt.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
哦，James属于
朱诺最古老、最富有的
家族之一。他们一切都
很顺利，但在Allysia死后
不久，家族就破产了。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
The city manages their
old residence now. For
some reason, they decided
to entrust me with the master
key to the Rosimier Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
现在城市接管了
他们的旧宅。
不知为何，他们决定
把Rosimier宅邸的
主钥匙交给我保管。

scripts.text: May I borrow the Master Key?
scripts.translation: 借用主钥匙

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Well, I'm really not
supposed to give it to just
anyone, but I can tell that
you're working with Allysia's
best interests at heart.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
虽然按规定我不应该随便把钥匙借给任何人，但我能感觉到，你是真心为了艾莉西亚的利益着想的。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
However, you've got to
make sure that you return
it to me before the people
from City Hall ask me for it.
Alright then, I hope you find
what you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
不过，你一定要在市政厅的人来找我之前把钥匙还给我。
好了，希望你能找到你要找的东西。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Please hurry and find
whatever you're searching
for in the Rosimier Mansion.
I might get in trouble if
the people from City Hall
come and ask me for the key...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
请快点在罗西米尔宅邸里找到你要找的东西。
如果市政厅的人来找我索要钥匙，我可能会惹上麻烦...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oh, you're finished
searching the mansion?
Depressing, isn't it?
The creditors basically
ransacked everything
a very long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
哦，你搜完宅邸了吗？
真令人沮丧，不是吗？
很久以前，债主们就已经把这里翻得底朝天了。

scripts.text: Why did ^3355FFAllysia^000000...?

[Old Lady]
Well, I know that James
and Allysia were in love,
and he promised to marry
her. Now, supposedly his
family already betrothed
him to another woman.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
嗯，我知道詹姆斯和艾莉西亚是相爱的，他也承诺要娶她。但据说他的家族已经为他许下了另一门亲事。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Time went by, and he
was forced to marry his
fiancee. Allysia was pretty
devastated. I think maybe
that's what she... you know...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
时间一天天过去，他被迫娶了那位未婚妻。艾莉西亚非常痛苦。我想，也许就是因此...你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Listen, if you want to learn
more about what happened,
then I think you should talk
to the ^3355FFfisherman that lives^000000
^3355FFsouth of the Kiel Hyre Academy.^000000
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
听着，如果你想了解更多
关于这件事的真相，
我想你应该去和
^3355FF基尔·海尔学院南边^000000
^3355FF住着的渔夫^000000谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
He's the one that found
Allysia's body in the river,
so he might have a better
idea of what had happened.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
就是他发现了艾莉西亚的尸体，所以他可能对当时发生的事有更清楚的了解。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
These days, it's much
harder to catch and fish.
Ever since they built
this factory, the fish
have started to change,
and they look different too...

[渔夫]
最近，捕鱼变得困难多了。
自从建了那座工厂，鱼就开始变异，
样子也变了……

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Eh? You want something?
Heh, youngsters! I know
how much you love handouts,
but you're not getting any.
Now, if you bring me some
Raw Fish, I'd be more friendly~
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
嗯？你想要什么？
嘿，年轻人！我知道你们喜欢白拿东西，
但我可不会给。不过，如果你给我带些生鱼片，
我会更友善一点~

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Oh, is all this fish
for me? Heh, how very
generous of you. If you're
going to be so kind, then
I suppose I have to repay
the favor. Ask me anything~
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
哦，这些鱼都是给我的？
嘿，你真是大方。既然你这么客气，
那我得回报一下。尽管问我吧~

scripts.text: 30 years ago, a woman killed herself...
scripts.translation: 30年前，有个女人自杀了……

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Oh? Ohh. Oh yeah.
I remember that. Yeah.
it was August 20th, my
wife's birthday. That day,
instead of catching fish,
I caught a dead woman.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
哦？噢。噢，是的。
我记得那件事。是的。
那是8月20日，我妻子的生日。那天，
我没有捕到鱼，却捞上来一具女尸。

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Of course, I reported it
to the Juno Police!  They told
me she killed herself since
she was betrayed by her lover,
who also happened to be her
employer. Really tragic stuff.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
当然，我立刻报了朱诺警察！
他们说她是自杀，因为她被情人背叛了，
而那个人恰好也是她的雇主。真是悲惨的故事。

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Anyway, when they were
moving her body out of the
river, her hand dropped
some ring. I picked it up,
hoping to sell it later for
some zeny. I know, I know...
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
总之，当他们把她的尸体从河里拖出来时，
她的手掉出了一枚戒指。我捡了起来，
想着以后卖掉换点Zeny。我知道，我知道……

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
I was pretty lucky the
police didn't see me take
it. Later that day, some guy
came up to me and offered
me a lot of money for it.
I guess it was my lucky day!
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
我很幸运警察没看到我捡走它。
那天晚些时候，有个家伙找到我，
出高价买下了它。我想那是我的幸运之日！

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
I found out later that he was
some mechanical repairman--
something. He sold everything
to buy that ring, so I guess
he wanted it desperately.
Then he just dissapeared.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
后来我才知道，他是个机械修理工之类的。
他卖掉了所有东西来买那枚戒指，看来他非常渴望得到它。
然后他就消失了。

scripts.text: Do you remember his name?
scripts.translation: 你记得他的名字吗？

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
His name...?
It was something like...
Heil? Hyre? Anyway, it
was a long time ago. Oh,
his old house is still around.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
他的名字……？
好像是……
海因？海雷？总之，那是很久以前的事了。噢，
他的老房子还在。

scripts.text:

If you're going to be
that curious, you might
as well check it out.

a hut near the northeast
forest guard camp.
scripts.translation:

不妨去看看。
让我想想，他住在东北森林卫兵营地附近的一间小屋里。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I'm surprised you made
it this far, adventurer~
I bid you welcome to my
humble room. I assume that
you've come for the Condensed
Memory Scroll... my mind.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
没想到你能走到这一步，冒险者~
欢迎来到我的房间。我想你是为了浓缩记忆卷轴...也就是我的大脑而来的吧。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
You can understand
why I can't let you have it,
so if you really want the
Condensed Memory Scroll,
then show me what you've got!
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
你应该明白我为什么不能把它给你。
如果你真的想要浓缩记忆卷轴，
那就让我看看你的实力吧！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Hmpf! You're pretty good.
Father must have spent
a lot of money to hire
you. So has he sent
you to kill me?
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
哼！你还挺厉害的。
神父一定花了不少钱雇你。
所以，他是派你来杀我的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kiel Hyre sent me to ask
you to stop turning all of
the Third Generation robots
into killing machines! How
can do something like that
to other robots like you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
基尔·海尔派我来，
是让你停止将第三代机器人
改造成杀戮机器！
你怎么能对像你一样的其他机器人
做出这种事？

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Why not? It's said that man
was made in the image of God.
Well, robots were made in the
image of man. You humans kill
each other as much as you
like, as far as I can tell.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
为什么不行？据说人类是按上帝的形象创造的。
那么，机器人就是按人类的形象创造的。
据我所知，你们人类
想怎么互相杀戮都可以。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
It might not be ethical
for me to provide weapons
to humans that need them...
But that's what they are.
Weapons. It's more humane
for robots to fight than humans.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
对我来说，把武器提供给需要它们的人类
可能并不符合伦理...
但那就是武器。让机器人战斗
比让人类战斗更有人道。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Robots don't naturally
feel pain or emotions...
Not unless they're specially
programmed. Sorry, but I don't
plans to stop what I'm doing.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
机器人天生不会感到疼痛或情绪...
除非经过特别编程。抱歉，但我
没有停止手头工作的计划。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I am sorry, but I don't have a plan to stop what I am doing.
Aside from that, my father showed me a great example of
how far a human could go for his own selfinishness by destroying a family.
And therefore I don't think that he could create better robots than mine.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
很抱歉，但我没有停止手头工作的计划。
除此之外，我的父亲向我展示了一个很好的例子，
说明人类为了自己的自私可以走多远，甚至毁灭了一个家庭。
因此，我认为他创造不出比我更好的机器人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Humankind may not be
perfect, but think about
who you're working with!
Rekenber is the epitome of
human evil! How can you
support them like this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人类也许并不完美，但想想
你是在和谁合作吧！
雷肯贝是人性之恶的极致！
你怎么能这样支持他们？

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I've had a long relationship
with Rekenber. I'm fully aware
of their capabilities. Do you
remember the first room you
passed on your way here, the
one with all the toys?
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我和雷肯贝有着长期的关系。我完全
了解他们的能力。你还记得你来的路上
经过的第一个房间吗，
那个摆满玩具的房间？

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I bet you didn't know that there
were 5 Second Generation
robots. Me, and my four other
brothers and sisters. Father
built that room so that all
five of us could live together.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我敢打赌你不知道那里有
5个第二代机器人。我，以及我的
四个兄弟姐妹。父亲建造那个房间，
是为了让我们五个能住在一起。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I was the only one to
survive. I returned to
Father and even got a
name. But yes, I know
how bad Rekenber really is...
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
只有我活了下来。我回到了
父亲身边，甚至得到了一个名字。但没错，我知道
雷肯贝有多坏...

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I don't... I don't want
to talk about this any more.
You've made me... Just leave.
I think I will let you live.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我...我不想再谈这个了。
你让我...快走吧。
我想我会让你活着的。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Freeze!
Kiehl Hyre, you're
under arrest for creating
and trading illegal weapons!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
站住！
基尔·海尔，你因制造和
非法交易武器而被逮捕！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Ah, Schwarzwald Republic
agents. Heh. I haven't had
this many guests before.
Well, I guess this means
we'll have to fight after
all, you and I. *Sigh* Pity.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
啊，修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的特工。呵。我以前
没接待过这么多客人。
好吧，看来我们
终究还是要打一架了，你和我。*叹气* 真遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
First, in all fairness,
let me take care of these
nuisances. They're just
mindlessly doing their
jobs--sort of like robots-- but
don't worry, they won't be hurt.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
首先，为了公平起见，
让我先处理掉这些麻烦。他们只是在
盲目地执行任务——有点像机器人——
但别担心，他们不会受伤。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Nooooo!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
不——！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
And now, you and I can
have a proper duel, human.
I'm interested in seeing just
how strong you really are~
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
现在，你和我可以
来一场真正的决斗了，人类。
我很好奇，你究竟有多强~

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
D-damn...!
Well played, adventurer.
Well played. I should have
known that Father would send
the very best after me. Still,
you've failed to truly defeat me.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
该死...！
干得漂亮，冒险者。
干得漂亮。我本该知道
神父会派最强的人来对付我。不过，
你并没有真正击败我。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I still have a few
trump cards left
I think... I'll take you
to hell with me... Well,
if robots can go there~
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我还有几张
王牌没出呢
我想...我会带你
一起下地狱...好吧，
如果机器人也能去那里的话~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
No...! We're locked
in the room! We're...
We're trapped in here!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
不...！我们被锁
在房间里了！我们...
我们被困在这里了！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Yay~ Let's burn
everything down~
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
耶~ 让我们
把这里烧个精光~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Quick, {0},
use Kiel Hyre's power
device, the one that's
supposed to mess with
Kiehl's power supply!
Hurry, use it right now!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
快，{0}，
使用基尔·海尔的
电力装置，那个
专门用来干扰基尔
电源的设备！
快，现在就用！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Wh-what? I c-can't
move! This day is just
full of surprises. Oh, well.
I guess it's time for me to
use my other trump card.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
什...什么？我动
不了了！今天真是
充满了惊喜。好吧。
看来是时候让我
使出另一张王牌了。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
What...?
How many trump
cards do you have?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
什么...？
你到底还有多少
张王牌？

scripts.text:
[????]
I'm so disappointed...
I can't believe none
of you thought of this.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
真让人失望...
真不敢相信
你们竟然没想到这一点。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Who are you...?
Show yourself!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
你是谁...？
出来吧！

scripts.text:
[????]
Please.
Don't insult me.
You know this voice.
It's been talking to
you this entire time~
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
拜托。
别侮辱我。
你认识这个声音。
它一直在和你说话~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Impossible...
How can there
be two of you...?!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
不可能...
怎么会有
两个你...？！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Hahahahaha!
I'm a robot!
I can make extra
bodies, switch brains
with them. It's awfully
convenient, let me tell you.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
哈哈哈哈！
我是机器人！
我可以制造
额外的身体，并与它们
交换大脑。相信我，
这非常方便。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Anyway, I don't mean to show
off, but I suppose I better
reveal to you my final trump
card. First of all, I know all
about you, Ms. Mitchell Layla~
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
总之，我不想
炫耀，但我想我最好
向你展示我的最后一张
王牌。首先，我对你
了如指掌，米切尔·蕾拉小姐~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
What? How do you
know my name?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
什么？你怎么
知道我的名字？

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Well, I have a few
spies of my own...
I'll allow him to explain...
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
嗯，我也有
几个间谍...
我让他来解释吧...

scripts.text:
[Masked Man]
Mitchell...
I'm sorry that
you had to get
involved in all this...
scripts.translation:
[蒙面男子]
米切尔...
很抱歉
让你卷入了这一切...

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Wolkeus? Wolkeus Kaiser?!
You're the spy?! But you risked
your life to save our president!
No! Oh, God! How can this be
happening?! Everything's just...
This is all crazy! All of it!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
沃尔凯乌斯？沃尔凯乌斯·凯撒？！
你是间谍？！但你曾
冒着生命危险救了我们的总统！
不！天哪！这怎么可能
发生？！一切都...
这太疯狂了！全都是！

scripts.text:
[Wolkeus]
This is just the result
of elaborate plans that
were made years ago. I didn't
expect you to be this surprised,
Mitchell. It's the way the game
is played. You know that.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔凯乌斯]
这只是多年前
精心策划的结果。我没想到
你会这么惊讶，米切尔。这就是
游戏的规则。你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Mister President...
I failed you... I'm sorry...
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
总统先生...
我辜负了您...对不起...

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Well, Kaiser, she took
it pretty badly, but at least
you're being gentlemanly
about it. Well, I'd like for
all of us to get better
acquainted, but...
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
嗯，凯撒，她虽然反应很激烈，但至少你表现得像个绅士。我想大家应该多熟悉一下，但是...

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
We'd better say our
farewells here. This
place will be gone in
five minutes. Ah, and
Ms. Layla, you're coming
with us. We have questions~
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我们最好在这里告别了。这个地方五分钟后就会消失。啊，对了，蕾拉小姐，你要跟我们走。我们还有问题要问~

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I'm curious as to what
the president's plans are.
Mister Kaiser, if you'll
escort Ms. Layla, please...
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我很好奇总统的计划是什么。凯撒先生，麻烦你护送一下蕾拉小姐...

scripts.text:
[Wolkeus Kaiser]
...............................
Sorry, Mitchell.
I gotta do it.

[Mitchell]
No, get away! Let me go!
Let go of me, Wolkeus!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
不，放开我！让我走！
放开我，沃尔凯乌斯！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Great, we're done with
that ugly business. Now,
where was I? Ah, right.
Yes. I'm sorry. We don't
have any more time to play.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
很好，那件丑事结束了。那么，我刚才说到哪了？啊，对了。
是的，抱歉。我们没时间再胡闹了。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Here, adventurer.
I'm aware that my father
sent you here to get this.
Consider it my final gift
to him. I'm surprised he left
this ring inside me, though...
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
给你，冒险者。
我知道是我父亲派你来取这个的。
请把它当作我留给他的最后礼物吧。不过，我有点惊讶他居然把这枚戒指留在我体内...

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I imagine that it must
be precious to him. But
I wonder why he placed
it inside me? Well, anyway,
I have a message I'd like
for you to deliver to him.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我想这对他来说一定很珍贵。但我不知道他为什么把它放在我体内？总之，我有一句话想让你带给他。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
First... I guess we
should get rid of this
old thing. It was a good
body, and it's served me
well for 23 years. I'll miss
it. Rest well, old Kiehl.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
首先...我想我们应该处理掉这个旧东西。它是个好身体，也为我服务了23年。我会想念它的。安息吧，老基尔。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Now, this was the body
that my father made.
Please tell him that
this means that we're
no longer related to
each other at all.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
现在，这个身体是我父亲制造的。
请告诉他，这意味着我们从此不再有任何关系。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
The body I'm using right now?
I made it myself with the most
advanced technology. Consider
it... a Fourth Generation robot
body if you will. Father will
understand what I mean.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我现在使用的这个身体？
是我用最新技术自己制造的。
你可以把它看作...第四代机器人身体吧。父亲会明白我的意思。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Anyway, please tell him
that, and get his old ring
out of my old robot body,
and then give it to him. For
now, let's get out of here: we
just have 3 minutes to evacuate.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
总之，请告诉他这些，
然后从我旧的机器人身体里取出他的旧戒指，
再把它交给他。现在，我们得离开这里：我们只有3分钟撤离时间。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
You're a worthy opponent,
and a human I respect.
I don't know if we'll meet
again, but who knows?
Anyway, I'll open up the
exit for you. Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
你是值得尊敬的对手，
也是我所尊重的人类。
我不知道我们是否还会再见面，但谁知道呢？
总之，我会为你打开出口。再见~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou retrieve the
ring from the heart of
Kiehl's old robotic body.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你从基尔旧机器人身体的心脏中取出了戒指。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFKiehl's old
robotic body
stands alone,
lifeless and silent.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF基尔的旧机器人身体
独自伫立，
毫无生气，一片寂静。^000000
